You may have helped liberate the nation of Ravounel, or you might be involved in another rebellion, such as Pezzack’s, that studied Ravounel’s successes. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Kintargo Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
chelish rebel.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Kintargo Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

child of notoriety.name: Child of Notoriety
child of notoriety.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. Choose whether you've navigated your past through kindness or notoriety thus far. For the former, you're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Genealogy Lore skill, and you gain the Group Impression skill feat. For the latter, you're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill, and you gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. Connection: Valahask, an iruxi mystic Reputation Points: –1
child of notoriety.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 12
child of notoriety.details: For the former, you're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Genealogy Lore skill, and you gain the Group Impression skill feat. For the latter, you're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill, and you gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

child of the colony.name: Child of the Colony
child of the colony.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Island Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.
child of the colony.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 10
child of the colony.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Island Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.

child of the polis.name: Child of the Polis
child of the polis.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Diplomacy or the Society skill, as well as a Lore skill associated with one Iblydan city-state (Pol-Bailax or Pol-Dhuraxilis is recommended). If you choose Diplomacy, you gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat. If you choose Society, you gain the Streetwise skill feat.
child of the polis.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Diplomacy or the Society skill, as well as a Lore skill associated with one Iblydan city-state (Pol-Bailax or Pol-Dhuraxilis is recommended). If you choose Diplomacy, you gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat. If you choose Society, you gain the Streetwise skill feat.

child of the puddles.name: Child of the Puddles
child of the puddles.text: You grew up in the soggy, squalid quarter of Absalom known as the Puddles. You’re at home in tightly packed urban environments. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Absalom Lore skill. You gain the Steady Balance skill feat.
child of the puddles.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Absalom Lore skill. You gain the Steady Balance skill feat.

child of the twin village.name: Child of the Twin Village
child of the twin village.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in Diplomacy and Dreamlands Lore. You gain the ability to communicate with your twin in your dreams. You and your twin gain the effects of dream message every night, only between the two of you; this isn't a spell, but a natural effect. Unless your twin is another PC, your GM roleplays your twin or summarizes your interaction during these dreams.
child of the twin village.details: You're trained in Diplomacy and Dreamlands Lore.

child of westcrown.name: Child of Westcrown
child of westcrown.text: Whether you come from Westcrown or elsewhere, you hold the values of pre-Thrune Cheliax dear. You disdain the infernal government, but you are proud of your country and do not consider yourself a rebel. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Westcrown Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
child of westcrown.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Westcrown Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

chitterwood refugee.name: Chitterwood Refugee
chitterwood refugee.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Chitterwood Lore skill. You gain the Forged in Fire reaction. Forged in FireTrigger You take fire damage; Frequency once per day; Effect You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) against the triggering damage.
chitterwood refugee.details: You're trained in the Chitterwood Lore skill.

chosen one.name: Chosen One
chosen one.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. Decide with your GM the basics of the prophecy in which you're meant to play a major part. You're trained in one skill related to the prophecy, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the Prophecy's Pawn free action. Prophecy's Pawn (abjuration, divine, fortune) Trigger You fail a saving throw, attack roll, or skill check; Effect You twist the prophecy in your favor, which will have consequences later. Reroll the failed check. You must use the result of the second roll.
chosen one.details: You're trained in one skill related to the prophecy, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill.

circuit judge.name: Circuit Judge
circuit judge.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.
circuit judge.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

circus born.name: Circus Born
circus born.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Circus Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
circus born.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Circus Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

clan associate.name: Clan Associate
clan associate.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Highhelm Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat. Connection: You have no special connection or sponsor in Clan Tolorr. Reputation Points: +2
clan associate.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 12
clan associate.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Highhelm Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

clockfighter.name: Clockfighter
clockfighter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
clockfighter.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

clockwork researcher.name: Clockwork Researcher
clockwork researcher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.
clockwork researcher.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.

clockwork wonder.name: Clockwork Wonder
clockwork wonder.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Clockwork Lore skill. You gain the Improvise Tool skill feat.
clockwork wonder.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 9
clockwork wonder.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Clockwork Lore skill. You gain the Improvise Tool skill feat.

close ties.name: Close Ties
close ties.text: Your home is likely relatively close to the place of business or home of your NPC ally. During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time with your NPC ally and might have made plans to get together the next day on the first day of summer, perhaps have tea together. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because your NPC friend or ally suggested the experience would be fun or good for you, or because they'd done it the previous year at your urging and now “it's your turn.” Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Tea Lore skill.
close ties.source: Season of Ghosts Player's Guide pg. 11
close ties.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Tea Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat (choose a specialty associated with your allied NPC), and your allied NPC begins with an attitude of friendly toward the party (rather than indifferent, which is the initial norm for all Willowshore NPCs).

clown.name: Clown
clown.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Clown Lore skill. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat (comedy)
clown.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Clown Lore skill. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat (comedy)

codebreaker.name: Codebreaker
codebreaker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Cryptography Lore skill. You gain the Glean Contents skill feat.
codebreaker.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Cryptography Lore skill. You gain the Glean Contents skill feat.

combat carpenter.name: Combat Carpenter
combat carpenter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.
combat carpenter.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.

combat chaplain.name: Combat Chaplain
combat chaplain.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and a Lore skill associated with the deity you worship. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
combat chaplain.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and a Lore skill associated with the deity you worship. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

company agent.name: Company Agent
company agent.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Accounting Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
company agent.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 10
company agent.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Accounting Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

concordance researcher.name: Concordance Researcher
concordance researcher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in four of the following: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore.
concordance researcher.details: You're trained in four of the following: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore.

concordance scout.name: Concordance Scout
concordance scout.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and one of the following lore skills: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
concordance scout.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and one of the following lore skills: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

conscript.name: Conscript
conscript.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
conscript.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

conservator.name: Conservator
conservator.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in either the Crafting skill or the Thievery skill, and you're trained in either the Accounting Lore or the Underworld Lore skill. If you selected Crafting, you gain the Quick Repair skill feat. If you chose Thievery, you gain the Assurance (Thievery) skill feat. Connection: Ria, an oread gnome curator who studies rivethun traditions Reputation Points: +1
conservator.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 12
conservator.details: You're trained in either the Crafting skill or the Thievery skill, and you're trained in either the Accounting Lore or the Underworld Lore skill. If you selected Crafting, you gain the Quick Repair skill feat. If you chose Thievery, you gain the Assurance (Thievery) skill feat.

construction occultist.name: Construction Occultist
construction occultist.text: You are still well-regarded by the Builders League. Your party gains 1 Reputation Point with the Builders League at the start of the campaign. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Athletics or the Occultism skill, as well as the Architecture Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Hefty Hauler if you chose Athletics or Oddity Identification if you chose Occultism.
construction occultist.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Athletics or the Occultism skill, as well as the Architecture Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Hefty Hauler if you chose Athletics or Oddity Identification if you chose Occultism.

convocation scout.name: Convocation Scout
convocation scout.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
convocation scout.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

cook.name: Cook
cook.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Seasoned skill feat.
cook.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Seasoned skill feat.

corpse stitcher.name: Corpse Stitcher
corpse stitcher.text: The Reanimators appreciate your past service. Your party gains 1 Reputation Point with the Reanimators at the start of the campaign. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Zombie Lore skill. You gain your choice of either the Risky Surgery or Stitch Flesh skill feats.
corpse stitcher.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Zombie Lore skill.

council of thieves agent.name: Council of Thieves Agent
council of thieves agent.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Subtle Theft skill feat.
council of thieves agent.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Subtle Theft skill feat.

courier.name: Courier
courier.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill for your city of origin. You gain the Glean Contents skill feat.
courier.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill for your city of origin. You gain the Glean Contents skill feat.

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.
criminal.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

crown of chaos.name: Crown of Chaos
crown of chaos.text: This background is associated with the suit of Crowns. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat and are trained in a Lore about a specific terrain, as befits where you spent most of your childhood growing up. You also gain the following free action. Chaotic Destiny (fortune) Trigger You fail a saving throw during a combat; Frequency once per day; Effect Chaos intervenes on your behalf at the last instant as you fail a saving throw. Draw a harrow card and reroll the saving throw you failed.
crown of chaos.details: You gain the Charming Liar skill feat and are trained in a Lore about a specific terrain, as befits where you spent most of your childhood growing up.

crystal healer.name: Crystal Healer
crystal healer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plane of Earth Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.
crystal healer.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plane of Earth Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.

cultist.name: Cultist
cultist.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and a Lore skill related to your deity or cult. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.
cultist.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and a Lore skill related to your deity or cult. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.

curandero.name: Curandero
curandero.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Inoculation skill feat.
curandero.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Inoculation skill feat.

curious apprentice.name: Curious Apprentice
curious apprentice.text: You hope that becoming an adventurer will solve this, for adventurers can not only find themselves with sudden windfalls of cash, but also have a knack for discovering strange occult mysteries and objects in their journeys and quests. Your family likely doesn’t approve of your choice, especially if they expected you to follow a tradition or cashed in favors to secure your apprenticeship. Alternatively, you might still be trying to juggle two worlds and still work at your “day job,” in which case you might have even been given a small room in the back of the shop as your own to stay in.
curious apprentice.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 12
curious apprentice.details: You’re trained in the Occultism skill and the Poetry Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat (carrying around all those books builds muscles, after all!).

curse-marked.name: Curse-Marked
curse-marked.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Library Lore skill. As long as you are not cursed yourself (barring a class-based curse, such as that granted by the oracle), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on checks made to counteract curses, on saving throws to resist curses, and on any skill check to disable a hazard capable of inflicting a curse. If you are cursed, you instead gain a –2 circumstance penalty to these rolls.
curse-marked.source: Bastion of Blasphemies Player's Guide pg. 9
curse-marked.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Library Lore skill.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You are trained in Occultism and Curse Lore. You gain the Warding Sign reaction. You and the GM should determine the full effects of the curse, though you've staved most of them off for now. The GM determines the curse's lingering manifestations on you, which usually include at least a constant or very frequent thematic effect and occasional more dangerous effects.
cursed.details: You are trained in Occultism and Curse Lore.

cursed family.name: Cursed Family
cursed family.text: Rumors abound that your family is cursed. While that would explain several unfortunate events in your family history, you may or may not believe it. Regardless, odd coincidences plague your lineage, and perhaps even appear in your own life, and you have become used to spotting strangeness around you. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Curse Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.
cursed family.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Curse Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You are trained in the Diplomacy skill. You gain the Indomitable Act reaction. Indomitable Act Frequency once per day; Trigger You are about to attempt a check; Requirements You are frightened; Effect You lean into your fear, using it to embolden you. You can roll the triggering check twice and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect.
dauntless.details: You are trained in the Diplomacy skill.

deckhand.name: Deckhand
deckhand.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.
deckhand.source: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Hero's Handbook pg. 18
deckhand.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

dedicated delver.name: Dedicated Delver
dedicated delver.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in either the Athletics skill or the Survival skill, and you're trained in the Cave Lore skill. If you selected Athletics, you gain the Combat Climber skill feat. If you chose Survival, you gain the Terrain Expertise (Underground) skill feat. Connection: Ria, an oread gnome curator who studies rivethun traditions Reputation Points: +0
dedicated delver.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 12
dedicated delver.details: You're trained in either the Athletics skill or the Survival skill, and you're trained in the Cave Lore skill. If you selected Athletics, you gain the Combat Climber skill feat. If you chose Survival, you gain the Terrain Expertise (Underground) skill feat.

deep-sea diver.name: Deep-Sea Diver
deep-sea diver.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Plane of Water Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.
deep-sea diver.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Plane of Water Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.

defiant noble.name: Defiant Noble
defiant noble.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in the Society skill and either the Cheliax Lore or Legal Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.
defiant noble.details: Any Chelaxian aristocrat is trained to acknowledge House Thrune’s power and sing its praises, lest their entire dynasty be devastated and absorbed by a stronger house. You’re trained in the Society skill and either the Cheliax Lore or Legal Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.

demon hunted.name: Demon Hunted
demon hunted.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Strength, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against mental effects. For 1 minute after you witness a demon suffer from having its sin vulnerability triggered, this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus.
demon hunted.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

demon slayer.name: Demon Slayer
demon slayer.text: For over a century, Mendev led a multinational coalition against ever-growing abyssal invaders in the Worldwound, and the Pathfinder Society aided in the so-called Fifth Crusade that ultimately sealed the planar rift and defeated its demon armies. You might be a hardened recruit who clashed with the demons, or perhaps you were a survivor who lost everything to the fiendish armies and narrowly escaped—or was rescued by Pathfinders. Your exposure to the Worldwound has taught you vital lessons in identifying fiends and their magic. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.
demon slayer.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

dendrologist.name: Dendrologist
dendrologist.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Plane of Wood Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat for forests.
dendrologist.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Plane of Wood Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat for forests.

deputy.name: Deputy
deputy.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.
deputy.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

desert tracker.name: Desert Tracker
desert tracker.text: You’re at home blazing trails in the burning sands, and you made a living guiding or following creatures in the desert. You might be a native nomad, an experienced desert guide, a naturalist, a bandit driven into the dunes by the law—or all of the above. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Desert Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.
desert tracker.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Desert Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

destined for greatness.name: Destined for Greatness
destined for greatness.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Aroden Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat and can select Azlanti as one of your new languages.
destined for greatness.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Aroden Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat and can select Azlanti as one of your new languages.

detective.name: Detective
detective.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
detective.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

diobel pearl diver.name: Diobel Pearl Diver
diobel pearl diver.text: You spent a portion of your youth diving and gathering precious pearls under the attentive eyes of Kortos Consortium merchants. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Ocean Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.
diobel pearl diver.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Ocean Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.

discarded duplicate.name: Discarded Duplicate
discarded duplicate.text: You and the GM can work out how to incorporate your previous life into your story. The GM can keep this knowledge hidden even from you, or you or another character know what happened. You and the GM can also leave the information unspecified and fill it in later. You gain three free ability boosts. You choose two, and the GM chooses one based on the attributes of the character you were built to duplicate.
discarded duplicate.details: Using a mixture of fringe science and magic, you were commissioned and trained to emulate this person in every way, and have stood in for them in countless deadly circumstances.

disciple of the gear.name: Disciple of the Gear
disciple of the gear.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and a Lore skill for the deity you worship. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.
disciple of the gear.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and a Lore skill for the deity you worship. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

distant traveler.name: Distant Traveler
distant traveler.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and the other is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Diplomacy and Mercantile Lore. Long journeys invigorate you. When you make your daily preparations after spending the previous day traveling in exploration mode or the first time after using magic to travel a distance of at least 100 miles (or to another plane), your excitement and anticipation about what you might encounter next gives you a +1 status bonus to Will saves for the next 8 hours after your daily preparations.
distant traveler.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 14
distant traveler.details: You’re trained in Diplomacy and Mercantile Lore.

doomcaller.name: Doomcaller
doomcaller.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Occultism and Star Lore. You also gain the Stellar Misfortune action. Stellar Misfortune (divination, misfortune, occult) Frequency once per day; Trigger A creature you can see is about to attempt a saving throw, attack roll, or skill check; Requirements You must be under the night sky with the stars visible; Effect You call upon the power of a dooming star, exacerbating the target's bad luck. The target must roll the triggering check twice and take the worse result.
doomcaller.details: You're trained in Occultism and Star Lore.

dragon scholar.name: Dragon Scholar
dragon scholar.text: You’ve likely chosen to attend the Call for Heroes as a way to seek funds as an adventurer to afford more texts about dragons or perhaps out of a desire to encounter one in real life. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Dragon Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
dragon scholar.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 4
dragon scholar.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Dragon Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

dreamer of the verdant moon.name: Dreamer of the Verdant Moon
dreamer of the verdant moon.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Zevgavizeb Lore skill. You gain the Ravening's Desperation skill feat.
dreamer of the verdant moon.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Zevgavizeb Lore skill. You gain the Ravening's Desperation skill feat.

dreams of vengeance.name: Dreams of Vengeance
dreams of vengeance.text: Your deviant abilities are of either the dragon or the troll classification. If you choose dragon, you gain the Blasting Beams deviant feat with the fire type. If you choose troll, you gain the Titan Swing deviant feat. As a quirk, your pupils are shaped like curved arches. When you use a deviant ability, the centers of your pupils shine with light, like the glowing gateways of the Missing Moment. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiator Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.
dreams of vengeance.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiator Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.

driver.name: Driver
driver.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Driving Lore or Piloting Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with the chosen lore.
driver.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Driving Lore or Piloting Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with the chosen lore.

droskari disciple.name: Droskari Disciple
droskari disciple.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You gain the Skill Training skill feat, and you're trained in the Droskar Lore skill.
droskari disciple.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 65
droskari disciple.details: You gain the Skill Training skill feat, and you're trained in the Droskar Lore skill.

eager scofflaw.name: Eager Scofflaw
eager scofflaw.text: Traditionally, you might have family in town, but chances are that you’re estranged with some or all of them, and either lived on your own in a rented room in the southern part of town, or in abandoned buildings or alleys using your Society skill to Subsist. Ever since you’ve started to adventure, you’ve likely been living in a long-term rental at one of Sandpoint’s inns, or perhaps have arranged accommodations at a fellow party member’s home. Joining the adventuring party made sense, since it’s a great way to make money fast—provided you can stay alive. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost.
eager scofflaw.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 12
eager scofflaw.details: You’re trained in the Thievery skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Bon Mot skill feat.

eagle hunter.name: Eagle Hunter
eagle hunter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Pet general feat and the Train Animal skill feat, but you can use these feats only to gain and train eagles. Your trained eagles can perform the Aid action when you attempt a Nature, Perception, or Survival skill check. This benefit applies to only you and other characters with the eagle hunter background.
eagle hunter.details: You’ve trained your eagle to hunt with you, simultaneously becoming an extension of yourself and a trusted partner you can rely on. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Pet general feat and the Train Animal skill feat, but you can use these feats only to gain and train eagles. Your trained eagles can perform the Aid action when you attempt a Nature, Perception, or Survival skill check.

early explorer.name: Early Explorer
early explorer.text: In the past decade, the Pathfinder Society has clashed with demonic armies, meddled in politics, and more, but you joined the organization before everything seemed so complicated. Whether you’re a dedicated scholar of ruins or an explorer who just longs for months-long expeditions into the wilderness, you’re a Pathfinder to explore, report, and cooperate. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Pathfinder Society Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
early explorer.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Pathfinder Society Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

eclectic scholar.name: Eclectic Scholar
eclectic scholar.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Dwarven Pantheon Lore skill, an uncommonly broad Lore skill that pertains to Torag's faith and those faiths of his divine family. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat. Connection: Rosha Coppervein, a Blue Warder who married into Clan Tolorr Reputation Points: +0
eclectic scholar.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 13
eclectic scholar.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Dwarven Pantheon Lore skill, an uncommonly broad Lore skill that pertains to Torag's faith and those faiths of his divine family. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.

eclipseborn.name: Eclipseborn
eclipseborn.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free ability boost. Decide with the GM what catastrophic event coincided with your birth; you're trained in a Lore skill related to that event. You can cast ill omen as an occult innate spell once per day. After you Cast this Spell, but before you regain the ability to cast it the following day, the GM can force you to reroll a successful saving throw, attack roll, or skill check as misfortune finds its way back to you. This is a misfortune effect. If this effect causes you to fail the associated saving throw, attack roll, or skill check, you can cast ill omen again a second time that day.
eclipseborn.details: Decide with the GM what catastrophic event coincided with your birth; you're trained in a Lore skill related to that event.

eidolon contact.name: Eidolon Contact
eidolon contact.text: You've come into contact with a disembodied being of magical essence known as an eidolon. You might have forged a powerful conduit with that eidolon, allowing you to manifest it as a summoner, but it's much more likely that you lost contact over time, though not before learning a few half-remembered secrets. If you lost contact, you might have become an adventurer to try to reach the eidolon again, or to be sure that you're rid of it forever. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.
eidolon contact.details: You're trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion, and a Lore skill for the creature associated with your contacted eidolon (such as Angel Lore or Dragon Lore). You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

eldritch anatomist.name: Eldritch Anatomist
eldritch anatomist.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Fleshwarp Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Medicine
eldritch anatomist.details: You're a trained physician who can ably tend wounds of many kinds. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Fleshwarp Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Medicine

elementally infused.name: Elementally Infused
elementally infused.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. Choose one elemental plane: Air, Earth, Fire, Metal, Water, or Wood. You are trained in the corresponding Lore skill: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore. You also gain a cantrip according to your chosen plane: air gale blast; Earth: scatter scree; Fire: ignition; Metal: needle darts; Water spout, or wood root reading. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will.
elementally infused.details: You are trained in the corresponding Lore skill: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore.

emancipated.name: Emancipated
emancipated.text: The chance to become an adventurer has excited you for some time, as you hope to build a new life for yourself as a hero rewarded with fame and fortune. Joining the Call for Heroes is a great opportunity to find a group to adventure with. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Kintargo Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.
emancipated.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 4
emancipated.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Kintargo Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.

embargo survivor.name: Embargo Survivor
embargo survivor.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Survival and either the Sailing Lore or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Scrappy Defiance action Scrappy Defiance (mental) Frequency once per day; Trigger Your turn begins, and you are commanding a troop; Effect You encourage your followers to persevere against all hardships. The troop you command gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level which last for 1 minutes. If your troop’s size would be reduced due to damage, you can attempt a DC 16 flat check; on a success, your troop’s size isn’t reduced at that threshold until the end of your next turn.
embargo survivor.details: You’re trained in Survival and either the Sailing Lore or Warfare Lore skill.

emissary.name: Emissary
emissary.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill related to one city you've visited often. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
emissary.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill related to one city you've visited often. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

empty hand loyalist.name: Empty Hand Loyalist
empty hand loyalist.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Belkzen Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
empty hand loyalist.source: Triumph of the Tusk Player's Guide pg. 10
empty hand loyalist.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Belkzen Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

empty whispers.name: Empty Whispers
empty whispers.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Planar Rift Lore skill. You get a Planar Rift Lore check to sense planar rifts, even if you aren't specifically Investigating or Searching for them, as well as locations where magic has been used to remove the memory of an object or creature from existence.
empty whispers.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Planar Rift Lore skill.

energy scarred.name: Energy Scarred
energy scarred.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be Constitution and one is a free ability boost. Your innate magical trait is primal. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, negative, positive, or sonic. You are trained in a Lore skill associated with the chosen energy (such as Fire Lore) and you gain resistance to that energy type equal to half your level (minimum 1).
energy scarred.details: You are trained in a Lore skill associated with the chosen energy (such as Fire Lore) and you gain resistance to that energy type equal to half your level (minimum 1).

entertainer.name: Entertainer
entertainer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Theater Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.
entertainer.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Theater Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

envoy's alliance.name: Envoy's Alliance
envoy's alliance.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
envoy's alliance.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 9
envoy's alliance.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

escaped from time.name: Escaped from Time
escaped from time.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and the other is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Occultism and Architecture Lore. Your experience trapped in time for so long has had a unique side effect on your mind—when you’re startled or threatened, you see brief flashes of competing timelines that can help guide your reactions. You’ve learned how to interpret these strange occult visions to bolster your reflexes. You can always choose to roll Occultism for initiative; when you do so, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.
escaped from time.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 14
escaped from time.details: You’re trained in Occultism and Architecture Lore.

esoteric bookworm.name: Esoteric Bookworm
esoteric bookworm.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.
esoteric bookworm.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

ex-con token guard.name: Ex-Con Token Guard
ex-con token guard.text: You transferred to the Edgewatch, the Precipice Quarter's new precinct, in the hope that you might meet others who sought to help—not exploit—Absalom's misguided. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill and your choice of Legal Lore or Underworld Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to interact with Token Guards and convicted criminals such as prison inmates. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.
ex-con token guard.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 6
ex-con token guard.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill and your choice of Legal Lore or Underworld Lore. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.

ex-mendevian crusader.name: Ex-Mendevian Crusader
ex-mendevian crusader.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Pilgrim's Token skill feat.
ex-mendevian crusader.source: Quest for the Frozen Flame Player's Guide pg. 8
ex-mendevian crusader.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Pilgrim's Token skill feat.

faction opportunist.name: Faction Opportunist
faction opportunist.text: As the Pathfinder Society's influence has grown, so too did many of its factions become wealthier and more powerful. These factions relied on a host of Pathfinders and independent operatives alike to establish trade networks, shape national politics, and more, and you were among the specialists who helped one of these factions realize its goal. These events provided you countless opportunities to develop your own contacts and negotiating skills. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, plus either Guild Lore, Heraldry Lore, or Mercantile Lore. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
faction opportunist.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, plus either Guild Lore, Heraldry Lore, or Mercantile Lore. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

false medium.name: False Medium
false medium.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the Deceptive Worship skill feat.
false medium.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the Deceptive Worship skill feat.

farmhand.name: Farmhand
farmhand.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.
farmhand.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.

farmsteader.name: Farmsteader
farmsteader.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
farmsteader.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

fated rival.name: Fated Rival
fated rival.text: You and your GM work out who your rival is and how they fit in to your story. You become trained in two Lore skills related to your rival, which you and your GM choose. You gain two free attribute boosts; you choose one, and the GM chooses one to complement your rival. So long as you are not in the presence of your rival, you gain the Diehard general feat and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the doomed condition. When in the presence of your rival, you lose these benefits but gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and damage. If your rival becomes your ally or a member of your party, you gain the Diehard and save bonus benefits, as long as that’s the case.
fated rival.details: You become trained in two Lore skills related to your rival, which you and your GM choose.

favored.name: Favored
favored.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in Diplomacy, Performance, or Society. You're trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the Name Drop reaction. At the GM's discretion, you can ask your patron for further assistance and favors, such as monetary or political support. You must keep your patron's favor to avoid losing your benefits; what this entails is between you and the GM but usually implies never publicly speaking or acting against your patron's wishes. If you offend your patron, you lose Name Drop until you reconcile with them.
favored.details: You're a trained, elegant artist or entertainer for the upper echelon of society. You're trained in Diplomacy, Performance, or Society. You're trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

feral child.name: Feral Child
feral child.text: Choose one attribute boost. It must be to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. You are trained in Nature and Survival. You gain low-light vision (or darkvision if you already had low-light vision), imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet, and the Forager skill feat.
feral child.details: You are trained in Nature and Survival. You gain low-light vision (or darkvision if you already had low-light vision), imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet, and the Forager skill feat.

fey friend.name: Fey Friend
fey friend.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Fey Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
fey friend.source: Wardens of Wildwood Players Guide pg. 7
fey friend.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Fey Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

feybound.name: Feybound
feybound.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You are trained in Fey Lore and gain the Fey's Fortune free action. You gain an anathema as part of your pact with the fey. If you violate this anathema, you lose Fey's Fortune until you receive the effects of a successful atone ritual using the Nature skill. The exact anathema is up to you and the GM, but the most common requirement is that you must fulfill a single request from any fey who knows your name. Fey's Fortune (concentrate, fortune) Frequency once per day; Trigger You attempt a skill check and haven't yet rolled; Effect Roll the skill check twice and use the better result.
feybound.details: You are trained in Fey Lore and gain the Fey's Fortune free action.

field medic.name: Field Medic
field medic.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
field medic.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

fiendbreaking pilgrim.name: Fiendbreaking Pilgrim
fiendbreaking pilgrim.text: Today, with Tanglebriar relatively contained, the need for powerful weapons like Fiendbreaker may be lessened, but this treasured gift's legendary journey across the world is honored still by pilgrimages, during which a group of priests and worshippers from a wide range of faiths gather and carry Fiendbreaker out from Kyonin and back again to honor that legacy. The goal of these journeys isn't to deliver the staff where it's needed. Instead, it's a journey of self- discovery, where the petitioners meditates on Fiendbreaker, the legacy of its creator Jininsiel, and a promise among all pilgrims to stand against the demonic evil.
fiendbreaking pilgrim.details: You're trained in the Religion skill and the Treerazer Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat, can use Treerazer Lore checks in place of Perception when you attempt to Seek or Sense the Motive of a creature you suspect of being an agent of Treerazer.

fightbreaker.name: Fightbreaker
fightbreaker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill for the city or settlement you lived in when you became a Fightbreaker You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
fightbreaker.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill for the city or settlement you lived in when you became a Fightbreaker You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

finadar leshy.name: Finadar Leshy
finadar leshy.text: You are a leshy from Finadar Forest, originally created under the corruption of a cyclopean monolith. Though the Pathfinder Society managed to sever the monolith’s connection, freeing the forest and your people from its influence, you retain a trace, unnerving connection to the Abyss. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Abyssal Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
finadar leshy.source: PFS Scenario #1-15: The Blooming Catastrophe pg. 35
finadar leshy.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Abyssal Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

final blade survivor.name: Final Blade Survivor
final blade survivor.text: You fell prey to the whims of the Galtan mob and were scheduled for execution by final blade, but through skill—or sheer luck—you managed to talk your way out of it. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Revolution Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
final blade survivor.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Revolution Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

fire warden.name: Fire Warden
fire warden.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Plane of Fire Lore skill. You gain the Breath Control skill feat.
fire warden.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Plane of Fire Lore skill. You gain the Breath Control skill feat.

firebrand follower.name: Firebrand Follower
firebrand follower.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Athletics or the Performance skill, as well as the Firebrand Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill
firebrand follower.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Athletics or the Performance skill, as well as the Firebrand Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill

fireworks performer.name: Fireworks Performer
fireworks performer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Fireworks Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.
fireworks performer.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Fireworks Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

fleshwarp researcher.name: Fleshwarp Researcher
fleshwarp researcher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Fleshwarping Lore skill. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks made to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds on any creature with the fleshwarp trait. This bonus increases to +2 if you become a master in Medicine and to +3 if you become legendary.
fleshwarp researcher.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Fleshwarping Lore skill.

fogfen tale-teller.name: Fogfen Tale-Teller
fogfen tale-teller.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Swamp Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.
fogfen tale-teller.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Swamp Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.

folklore enthusiast.name: Folklore Enthusiast
folklore enthusiast.text: If you're religious, your home is likely near a shrine associated with your faith—if your faith isn't represented among Willowshore's shrines, speak with your GM about potentially having a shrine to your faith in or near to your home. During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time chatting with others about ghost stories and sharing spooky legends and tales. You weren't chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival so much as you volunteered, eagerly, for the chance—you might have even participated in previous years as an abductee! Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost.
folklore enthusiast.source: Season of Ghosts Player's Guide pg. 11
folklore enthusiast.details: You're trained in the Religion skill and the Art Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

food trader.name: Food Trader
food trader.text: You are still highly regarded by the Export Guild for your past journeys on the nation's behalf. Your party gains 1 Reputation Point with the Export Guild at the start of the campaign. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Seasoned if you chose Crafting or Streetwise if you chose Society.
food trader.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Seasoned if you chose Crafting or Streetwise if you chose Society.

foreign aid.name: Foreign Aid
foreign aid.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill a Lore skill pertaining to your place of origin. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.
foreign aid.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill a Lore skill pertaining to your place of origin. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.

foreign diplomat.name: Foreign Diplomat
foreign diplomat.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
foreign diplomat.source: Triumph of the Tusk Player's Guide pg. 10
foreign diplomat.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

former aspis agent.name: Former Aspis Agent
former aspis agent.text: For more than a century, the Pathfinder Society has clashed with the avaricious and underhanded Aspis Consortium, and several years ago the Society dealt its rival a decisive blow. You may be one of the few survivors of a doomed Aspis expedition, or perhaps you chafed at the Consortium’s villainous practices and defected to the Pathfinders. No matter your reasons, you know how to be efficient and ruthless when the circumstances demand. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Aspis Consortium Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
former aspis agent.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Aspis Consortium Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

fortune teller.name: Fortune Teller
fortune teller.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.
fortune teller.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

framed in ferrous quarter.name: Framed in Ferrous Quarter
framed in ferrous quarter.text: Maybe you hung out with the wrong crowd. Maybe it was just bad luck. Whatever the case, you were framed for a crime you didn't commit—larceny, smuggling, possibly even murder. You didn't stick around long enough to find out what, exactly, the shieldmarshals banging on your door were charging you with. Now, you're on the lam, uncertain where you'll be able to get a good night's sleep, let alone your next meal. At least one thing's for sure, though: before you turned heel and ran into the streets, you saw a telltale signature on the arrest warrant.
framed in ferrous quarter.source: Outlaws of Alkenstar Player's Guide pg. 12
framed in ferrous quarter.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.

free spirit.name: Free Spirit
free spirit.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill for a specific settlement or terrain you have traveled through. You gain the Forager skill feat.
free spirit.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill for a specific settlement or terrain you have traveled through. You gain the Forager skill feat.

freed slave of absalom.name: Freed Slave of Absalom
freed slave of absalom.text: As a recently freed slave in Absalom, you belong to a new, close-knit social class at the heart of the city’s most important trades. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Absalom Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
freed slave of absalom.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Absalom Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

friend of a friend.name: Friend of a Friend
friend of a friend.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill associated with any sort of food or drink You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison and disease, and to any checks made to counteract poison or disease.
friend of a friend.source: Bastion of Blasphemies Player's Guide pg. 10
friend of a friend.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill associated with any sort of food or drink You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison and disease, and to any checks made to counteract poison or disease.

friend of greensteeples.name: Friend of Greensteeples
friend of greensteeples.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Deception or Society skills, and gain the Assurance skill feat with your chosen skill. You're also trained in a Lore skill about a narrow category of creatures. Additionally, when you receive a mission briefing at Greensteeples Manor (or a briefing from Benedet or Varian Jeggare at another location), you receive a warm welcome. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
friend of greensteeples.details: You're trained in your choice of the Deception or Society skills, and gain the Assurance skill feat with your chosen skill. You're also trained in a Lore skill about a narrow category of creatures.

friendly darkmoon kobold.name: Friendly Darkmoon Kobold
friendly darkmoon kobold.text: It has taken time, but over the years, you've managed to find a place among the citizens of Falcon's Hollow. While many still distrust kobolds, they at least see you as a fellow villager, if not a friend, and you've got quite the talent for quickly convincing larger groups of people that you mean them no harm. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Kobold Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
friendly darkmoon kobold.source: Crown of the Kobold King pg. 9
friendly darkmoon kobold.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Kobold Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Games Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.
gambler.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Games Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

geb crusader.name: Geb Crusader
geb crusader.text: You grew up considering the existence of the undead nation of Geb an atrocity and trained to one day take part in destroying it and putting its vile inhabitants to their final rest. Key to your preparations is a thorough study of Pharasma, Urgathoa, and other undead-related deities and their philosophies. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.
geb crusader.details: Region Impossible Lands You grew up considering the existence of the undead nation of Geb an atrocity and trained to one day take part in destroying it and putting its vile inhabitants to their final rest. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.

genie-blessed.name: Genie-Blessed
genie-blessed.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Genie Lore skill. You gain the Wish for Luck free action. Wish for Luck (arcane, auditory, divination, fortune) Frequency once per day; Trigger You are about to roll an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check; Effect You wish aloud for success. Roll the check twice and take the higher result.
genie-blessed.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Genie Lore skill.

ghostwriter.name: Ghostwriter
ghostwriter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Scribing Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
ghostwriter.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Scribing Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.
gladiator.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

gloriana's fixer.name: Gloriana's Fixer
gloriana's fixer.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Subtle Theft skill feat. Additionally, when Gloriana Morilla is present during your mission briefings, she discreetly checks in with you and provides some pointers. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
gloriana's fixer.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Subtle Theft skill feat.

glory hound.name: Glory Hound
glory hound.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Intimidation or the Performance skill, as well as the Games Lore skill. If you choose Intimidation, you gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. If you choose Performance, you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.
glory hound.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Intimidation or the Performance skill, as well as the Games Lore skill. If you choose Intimidation, you gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. If you choose Performance, you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

goblinblood orphan.name: Goblinblood Orphan
goblinblood orphan.text: Your family, whether goblin, hobgoblin, or human, died in the Goblinblood Wars. Though you were marked by these losses, you managed to survive through your own resilience and resourcefulness. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Goblin Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Survival.
goblinblood orphan.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Goblin Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Survival.

goblinblood survivor.name: Goblinblood Survivor
goblinblood survivor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Goblin Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
goblinblood survivor.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Goblin Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

godless graycloak.name: Godless Graycloak
godless graycloak.text: You finally found a like mind in Captain Runewulf, "the Unbeliever", whose reputation and similar distaste for religion inspired you to join the Graycloaks. As a sworn protector of the Ascendant Court, you didn't differentiate between Sarenites or Pharasmins, Iomedaeans or Norgorberites; if you saw someone in danger, you put your life on the line to save them, whatever their place within or outside a church. Your good record has earned you a transfer-temporary or not, the choice is yours-to the newly formed Edgewatch, where you'll use your authority to guard the lives of not just Absalomians, but all who have come to your grand city to experience its wonders. Choose two ability boosts.
godless graycloak.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 6
godless graycloak.details: You're trained in the Religion skill and your choice of a specific religion Lore skill (such as Iomedae Lore or Norgorber Lore).

gold falls regular.name: Gold Falls Regular
gold falls regular.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, as well as your choice of the Cooking Lore skill or Volcano Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. Additionally, when you receive a mission briefing at Gold Falls Inn or a settlement in Darkmoon Vale, you can draw on your knowledge of the region and its many stories. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
gold falls regular.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, as well as your choice of the Cooking Lore skill or Volcano Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

goldhand arms dealer.name: Goldhand Arms Dealer
goldhand arms dealer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
goldhand arms dealer.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill skill of your choice. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
gossip.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill skill of your choice. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

grand archive.name: Grand Archive
grand archive.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
grand archive.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 9
grand archive.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

grand council bureaucrat.name: Grand Council Bureaucrat
grand council bureaucrat.text: You spent years working as a clerk to a functionary in Absalom’s government. Your service taught you a thing or two about rousing speeches and manipulating the city’s bureaucracy. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Government Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
grand council bureaucrat.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Government Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

grave robber.name: Grave Robber
grave robber.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.
grave robber.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

green faith pilgrim.name: Green Faith Pilgrim
green faith pilgrim.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Green Faith Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.
green faith pilgrim.source: Wardens of Wildwood Players Guide pg. 7
green faith pilgrim.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Green Faith Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.

green touched.name: Green Touched
green touched.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herbology Lore skill. You gain the Green Thumb action.
green touched.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herbology Lore skill.

grizzled muckrucker.name: Grizzled Muckrucker
grizzled muckrucker.text: Thankfully, you found an out: an invitation to transfer to the newly formed Edgewatch. You accepted the offer in the hope that some fresh experience in a new district, surrounded by new people, might reignite the hope and passion you felt for the job so long ago. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, as well as either Labor Lore or Underworld Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to interact with Muckruckers, mercenaries, and adventurers. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.
grizzled muckrucker.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 7
grizzled muckrucker.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, as well as either Labor Lore or Underworld Lore. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

guard.name: Guard
guard.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Legal Lore skill or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
