guard.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Legal Lore skill or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

guest of sedeq lodge.name: Guest of Sedeq Lodge
guest of sedeq lodge.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Religion skills, as well as your choice of the Genie Lore or Sarenrae Lore skills. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat. Additionally, when you receive a mission briefing at Sedeq Lodge, your familiarity with the site and the nearby area comes in handy. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
guest of sedeq lodge.details: You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Religion skills, as well as your choice of the Genie Lore or Sarenrae Lore skills. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.
gunsmith.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

hammered by fate.name: Hammered by Fate
hammered by fate.text: This background is associated with the suit of Hammers. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength, and one is a free ability boost. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat and are trained in one of the following Lore skills, as fits your history: Daemon Lore, Demon Lore, or Devil Lore. You also gain the following free action. Harrow the Fiend (fortune) Trigger You start your turn in combat against a foe or foes you recognize to be fiends; Frequency once per day; Effect You gain a +1 status bonus on all Strikes or spell attack rolls against fiends for the duration of combat.
hammered by fate.details: You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat and are trained in one of the following Lore skills, as fits your history: Daemon Lore, Demon Lore, or Devil Lore.

harbor guard moonlighter.name: Harbor Guard Moonlighter
harbor guard moonlighter.text: Despite the decline in your performance, Lieutenant Lavarsus of Edgewatch sees potential (and even, maybe, a bit of himself) in you. You're eager to be on a new unit and for the chance to bring your monster-hunting skills to a district that has been plagued by such supernatural beasts for far too long. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill and your choice of Sailing Lore or Hunting Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to interact with Harbor Guards, ship captains, and freelance adventurers. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat.
harbor guard moonlighter.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 7
harbor guard moonlighter.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill and your choice of Sailing Lore or Hunting Lore. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat.

hardened criminal.name: Hardened Criminal
hardened criminal.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Prison Lore skill. Your formidable demeanor makes people want to stay on your good side (or at least stay out of your way) rather than challenge you. Creatures you successfully Coerce don't become unfriendly after doing what you want, so long as those creatures weren't already unfriendly or hostile to you and provided your commands don't leave them with no choice but to become unfriendly or worse, as determined by the GM.
hardened criminal.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Prison Lore skill.

harrow-chosen.name: Harrow-Chosen
harrow-chosen.text: Select one card from the harrow deck and note its suit and alignment. The suit is connected to a specific ability score (hammers [Strength], keys [Dexterity], shields [Constitution], books [Intelligence], stars [Wisdom], crowns [Charisma]). Choose two ability boosts. One must be to the ability score tied to your card's suit and one is a free ability boost. You gain the ability to cast a common occult innate cantrip of your choice and can cast the cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell level equal to half your level rounded up.
harrow-chosen.source: Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds pg. 67

harrow-led.name: Harrow-Led
harrow-led.text: Randomly determine two harrow suits tied to your character, each reflecting a specific ability score. You can do so by drawing cards from a harrow deck or by rolling a d6: 1 = hammers (Strength), 2 = keys (Dexterity), 3 = shields (Constitution), 4 = books (Intelligence), 5 = stars (Wisdom), 6 = crowns (Charisma). The first suit is your aligned score, and the second suit is your misaligned score. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to your aligned or misaligned score, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Occultism, Performance, or Society skill and the Harrow Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
harrow-led.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven pg. 66
harrow-led.details: You're trained in your choice of the Occultism, Performance, or Society skill and the Harrow Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

haunted.name: Haunted
haunted.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You are trained in Occultism and an additional skill in which the haunting entity is well-versed, determined by the GM. Any time you attempt a skill check for the entity's skill, the GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus to the check, as though the entity were Aiding you. If you accept but fail the check, you are frightened 2 (frightened 4 on a critical failure). The initial frightened value can't be reduced by effects that would reduce or prevent the condition (such as a fighter's bravery).
haunted.details: You are trained in Occultism and an additional skill in which the haunting entity is well-versed, determined by the GM.

haunted citizen.name: Haunted Citizen
haunted citizen.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill for your home settlement. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.
haunted citizen.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill for your home settlement. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.

haunting vision.name: Haunting Vision
haunting vision.text: Your latest dream, for the first time, had enough details to identify its setting—in this last dream, you saw the town of Breachill burning. You’ve decided to join the Call for Heroes hoping to save the town you fear might burn to the ground soon. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Dahak Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.
haunting vision.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 4
haunting vision.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Dahak Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.

hell-hunted.name: Hell-Hunted
hell-hunted.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Stealth and either the Devil Lore or Hellknight Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.
hell-hunted.details: You’re trained in Stealth and either the Devil Lore or Hellknight Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.

hellknight deserter.name: Hellknight Deserter
hellknight deserter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Hellknight Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
hellknight deserter.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Hellknight Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

hellknight historian.name: Hellknight Historian
hellknight historian.text: You decided to join the Call for Heroes to hoping to gain an opportunity to explore Citadel Altaerein. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.
hellknight historian.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 5
hellknight historian.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.
herbalist.details: As a formally trained apothecary or a rural practitioner of folk medicine, you learned the healing properties of various herbs. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.

hermean expatriate.name: Hermean Expatriate
hermean expatriate.text: You have been exiled from Hermea, perhaps of your own accord or perhaps because you didn't measure up. However, you take with you some of the benefits of the excellent education afforded to its citizenry. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Dragon Lore skill. You gain the Skill Training skill feat.
hermean expatriate.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Dragon Lore skill. You gain the Skill Training skill feat.

hermean heritor.name: Hermean Heritor
hermean heritor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat or the Assurance skill feat for Society.
hermean heritor.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat or the Assurance skill feat for Society.

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Nature or the Occultism skill, as well as a Lore skill related to the terrain you lived in as a hermit (such as Cave Lore or Desert Lore). You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
hermit.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Nature or the Occultism skill, as well as a Lore skill related to the terrain you lived in as a hermit (such as Cave Lore or Desert Lore). You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

heroic ancestry.name: Heroic Ancestry
heroic ancestry.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Strength, and the other is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Athletics and Library Lore. The disconnect between physical accomplishments and scholastic accomplishments has never been a particular challenge for you, and while this has caused jealousy now and then with childhood friends and rivals, you’ve managed to hone your skills so that regardless of who you’re talking to, your knack of being able to find a common ground has made it easy to make a good impression. Whenever you take part in an influence encounter to Discover or Influence, or attempt to Make an Impression on an NPC, you reduce the DC of those checks by 2.
heroic ancestry.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 14
heroic ancestry.details: You’re trained in Athletics and Library Lore.

highborn snoop.name: Highborn Snoop
highborn snoop.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Guild Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.
highborn snoop.details: The machinations and scheming of King's Crown have trained you to be on the lookout for those who seem out of place. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Guild Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.

hinji beachcomber.name: Hinji Beachcomber
hinji beachcomber.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Fishing Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
hinji beachcomber.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Fishing Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

hired killer.name: Hired Killer
hired killer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat, choosing a terrain appropriate for where you make your kills.
hired killer.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat, choosing a terrain appropriate for where you make your kills.

historical reeanactor.name: Historical Reeanactor
historical reeanactor.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in either the Performance skill or the Society skill, and you're trained in the Dwarf Lore skill. If you selected Performance, you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. If you chose Society, you gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat. Connection: Bulgra Veldollow, a matriarch in Clan Tolorr and accomplished puppeteer Reputation Points: +0
historical reeanactor.source: Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide pg. 13
historical reeanactor.details: You're trained in either the Performance skill or the Society skill, and you're trained in the Dwarf Lore skill. If you selected Performance, you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. If you chose Society, you gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

hookclaw digger.name: Hookclaw Digger
hookclaw digger.text: You are a digger from the Hookclaw kobold tribe, born beneath the streets of Absalom, with muscles and mind hardened by years spent tunneling through rock and earth and a confidence built upon your pride in your draconic heritage. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, the Mining Lore skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Improvise Tool skill feat.
hookclaw digger.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, the Mining Lore skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Improvise Tool skill feat.

horizon hunters.name: Horizon Hunters
horizon hunters.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.
horizon hunters.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 10
horizon hunters.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.

hounded thief.name: Hounded Thief
hounded thief.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.
hounded thief.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.

hunted by the night.name: Hunted by the Night
hunted by the night.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Vampire Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat. In addition, you begin play ready to protect yourself from your supernatural stalker. You have a religious symbol, a wooden stake and mallet, and a vial of holy water.
hunted by the night.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 10
hunted by the night.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Vampire Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Tanning Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.
hunter.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Tanning Lore skill. You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.

immortal influence.name: Immortal Influence
immortal influence.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Deskari Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
immortal influence.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 9
immortal influence.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Deskari Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

inexplicably expelled.name: Inexplicably Expelled
inexplicably expelled.text: Unfortunately, your victory was short-lived. Just as you were you making significant headway on a promising series of explosive experiments, you found a letter on your desk informing you that, effective immediately, you were permanently expelled from Blythir College. As bogus as the punishment was, the charges leveled against you were even more puzzling: theft of property, both intellectual and physical. And just like that, you found your prestigious honors replaced with a ruined reputation, and your colleagues and mentors became bitter rivals and accusers. In an instant, you'd gone from promising scholar to wanted criminal.
inexplicably expelled.source: Outlaws of Alkenstar Player's Guide pg. 12
inexplicably expelled.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Alchemical Crafting skill feat.

inlander.name: Inlander
inlander.text: You grew up in an untamed region of the Isle of Kortos, and you know how to survive in the wild. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to the terrain type associated with your home region (such as Hills Lore or Mountains Lore) You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.
inlander.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to the terrain type associated with your home region (such as Hills Lore or Mountains Lore) You gain the Survey Wildlife skill feat.

insurgent.name: Insurgent
insurgent.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Lengthy Diversion skill feat.
insurgent.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Lengthy Diversion skill feat.

iolite trainee hobgoblin.name: Iolite Trainee Hobgoblin
iolite trainee hobgoblin.text: The Iolite Squad was Oprak's first foray into training hobgoblins for Pathfinder membership. You've added the archival and archaeological skills they sent back to Oprak into your military training. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Sign Language skill feat.
iolite trainee hobgoblin.source: PFS Scenario #1-19: Iolite Squad Alpha pg. 30
iolite trainee hobgoblin.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Sign Language skill feat.

isgeri reclaimer.name: Isgeri Reclaimer
isgeri reclaimer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Isger Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat in either rubble or underbrush. You know Hallit as a free additional language.
isgeri reclaimer.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Isger Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat in either rubble or underbrush.

issian partisan.name: Issian Partisan
issian partisan.text: You grew up among the northern houses of Brevoy in old Issia. Steeped in the cultural legacy of pirates and smugglers, you rely on your cleverness and charm as you make your way throughout the world. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
issian partisan.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

issian patriot.name: Issian Patriot
issian patriot.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
issian patriot.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

jeweler.name: Jeweler
jeweler.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Gem Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.
jeweler.details: You’re a trained jeweler with an eye for structure and beauty. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Gem Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.

junk collector.name: Junk Collector
junk collector.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill or Mining Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.
junk collector.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill or Mining Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.

junker.name: Junker
junker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill of the terrain in which you scavenge. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
junker.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill of the terrain in which you scavenge. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

kaiju stalker.name: Kaiju Stalker
kaiju stalker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Athletics and gain one Athletics skill feat of your choice, best suited toward the style of hunting you prefer. You’re trained in Kaiju Lore. When rolling a Recall Knowledge check using Kaiju Lore and you have sight of one item that belongs to the kaiju you’re attempting to Recall Knowledge about, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the skill check. The item can range from a scale to slime, to a footprint, or to crafted or harvested goods.
kaiju stalker.details: You’re trained in Athletics and gain one Athletics skill feat of your choice, best suited toward the style of hunting you prefer. You’re trained in Kaiju Lore.

kalistrade follower.name: Kalistrade Follower
kalistrade follower.text: You follow the philosophy of the Prophecies of Kalistrade, seeking to build up your wealth in this life so that you might meet the next world on your own terms. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Kalistrade Lore skill. You gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat.
kalistrade follower.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Kalistrade Lore skill. You gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat.

kartaji epicurean.name: Kartaji Epicurean
kartaji epicurean.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.
kartaji epicurean.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.

keys to destiny.name: Keys to Destiny
keys to destiny.text: This background is associated with the suit of Keys. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity, and one is a free ability boost. You gain the Assurance general skill feat and are trained in one of the following Lore skills associated with a profession, as befits your history: Art Lore, Engineering Lore, Farming Lore, Herbalism Lore, Labor Lore, Mercantile Lore, Scribing Lore, Theater Lore, or Warfare Lore. You also gain the following free action. Lucky Break (fortune) Trigger You attempt a skill check during Exploration or Downtime; Frequency once per day; Effect Draw a harrow card, then reroll the skill check.
keys to destiny.details: You gain the Assurance general skill feat and are trained in one of the following Lore skills associated with a profession, as befits your history: Art Lore, Engineering Lore, Farming Lore, Herbalism Lore, Labor Lore, Mercantile Lore, Scribing Lore, Theater Lore, or Warfare Lore.

knack for contraptions.name: Knack for Contraptions
knack for contraptions.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You can cast live wire as an arcane innate cantrip. As normal, the cantrip heightens to half your level rounded up.
knack for contraptions.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 10
knack for contraptions.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill.

kyonin emissary.name: Kyonin Emissary
kyonin emissary.text: You were trained to be an ambassador of the elven land of Kyonin, and you have now been sent out into the wider world to build alliances between Kyonin and the neighboring kingdoms. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
kyonin emissary.details: Region Shining Kingdoms You were trained to be an ambassador of the elven land of Kyonin, and you have now been sent out into the wider world to build alliances between Kyonin and the neighboring kingdoms. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

laborer.name: Laborer
laborer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
laborer.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

lastwall survivor.name: Lastwall Survivor
lastwall survivor.text: You managed to escape the devastation that the Whispering Tyrant brought to your nation, but you lost everything to the lich-king’s minions, including your home and many friends and family. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
lastwall survivor.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

learned guard prodigy.name: Learned Guard Prodigy
learned guard prodigy.text: After no shortage of debating the pros and cons, you decided to transfer to the Edgewatch precinct. Sure, you have a keen understanding of the theories and principles behind law enforcement, but you've reasoned that in order to be a truly effective guard you'll need some first-hand experience in a high-risk area nabbing suspects and protecting innocents— all the while taking fastidious notes and writing your grand thesis on the merits and shortcomings of Absalom's laws. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Occultism skill, as well as Legal Lore.
learned guard prodigy.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 7
learned guard prodigy.details: You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Occultism skill, as well as Legal Lore. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

legacy of the hammer.name: Legacy of the Hammer
legacy of the hammer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Concealing Legerdemain skill feat.
legacy of the hammer.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Concealing Legerdemain skill feat.

legendary parents.name: Legendary Parents
legendary parents.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
legendary parents.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

lesser scion.name: Lesser Scion
lesser scion.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
lesser scion.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

ley seeker.name: Ley Seeker
ley seeker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the skill associated with the tradition of the ley line you encountered (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine). You're also trained in the Ley Line Lore skill. You can always use Ley Line Lore to Tap a Ley Line, regardless of the ley line's tradition. In addition, failing or critically failing to Tap a Ley Line doesn't prevent you from attempting to Tap that Ley Line again.
ley seeker.details: You're trained in the skill associated with the tradition of the ley line you encountered (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine). You're also trained in the Ley Line Lore skill.

library dweller.name: Library Dweller
library dweller.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Library Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.
library dweller.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Library Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.

lived through hell.name: Lived Through Hell
lived through hell.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.
lived through hell.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.

local brigand.name: Local Brigand
local brigand.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Banditry Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
local brigand.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Banditry Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

local savior.name: Local Savior
local savior.text: Eventually, this led you to join with your fellow PCs, and with their aid, you went from a local savior to an increasingly renowned hero. Yet even if you haven’t been back to your hometown, your heart and soul never really left, and the lessons you learned in those formative years of triumphs (and perhaps failures) have made you into the famous adventurer you are today. Queen Sorshen even complimented your early accomplishments in her invitation to you to attend the opening ceremonies for the Circle of Open Hands and mentioned how she’d like you to help inspire the people of Xin-Eurythnia to follow in your footsteps in making the capital city of New Thassilon a safe place to thrive.
local savior.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 15
local savior.details: You’re trained in Religion and Art Lore.

local scion.name: Local Scion
local scion.text: The Call for Heroes is one of your hometown’s most iconic traditions, and you want to attend so you can prove your own merits to the council—beyond simply those of your family’s name. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Breachill Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.
local scion.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 5
local scion.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Breachill Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.

lost and alone.name: Lost and Alone
lost and alone.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
lost and alone.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

lost coast local.name: Lost Coast Local
lost coast local.text: You might have family ties to one of Sandpoint’s original founding families, which included the Kaijitsus, the Valdemars, the Scarnettis, and the Deverins, although others were involved as well. Conversely, you might have family ties to the indigenous Varisians who have long regarded this part of the Lost Coast as home and who were part of the original accord with the Sandpoint Mercantile Guild that ensured Varisians a place in town and the opportunity to profit from Sandpoint’s success. As such, your home might be anywhere in Sandpoint, and could well be one of its larger buildings if your family has dwelled in town for long enough. Choose two ability boosts.
lost coast local.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 13
lost coast local.details: You’re trained in the Society skill and the Sandpoint Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

lost loved one.name: Lost Loved One
lost loved one.text: Your deviant abilities are of either the leech, or the wraith classification. If you choose leech, you gain the Draining Touch deviant feat. If you choose wraith, you gain the Ghostly Grasp deviant feat. As a quirk, whenever you use a deviant ability, a low, rattling moan emanates from some unseen maw in your vicinity. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
lost loved one.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

lost performer.name: Lost Performer
lost performer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Fey Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.
lost performer.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Fey Lore skill. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

lumber consortium laborer.name: Lumber Consortium Laborer
lumber consortium laborer.text: You have suffered as a worker for the unscrupulous Lumber Consortium, laboring under harsh conditions in dangerous wooded regions of Andoran. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Forest Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.
lumber consortium laborer.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Forest Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.

magaambya academic.name: Magaambya Academic
magaambya academic.text: You studied magic at the prestigious Magaambya academy in Nantambu, learning magical traditions dating back to Old-Mage Jatembe and earning a pedigree respected by magical scholars almost everywhere. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Arcana or the Nature skill, as well as the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
magaambya academic.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Arcana or the Nature skill, as well as the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

magical experiment.name: Magical Experiment
magical experiment.text: You gain one ability boost. It must be to Constitution. You're trained in Occultism and the Academia Lore skill. You gain one special ability as a result of the magical experimentation. Work with the GM to select an appropriate ability from the following list or to come up with another special ability. Enhanced Senses You gain low-light vision (or darkvision if you already had low-light vision) and an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, such as scent, thoughtsense, tremorsense, or wavesense. Resistant Skin The experiments rendered your skin tougher and resilient to a particular type of damage.
magical experiment.details: You're trained in Occultism and the Academia Lore skill.

magical merchant.name: Magical Merchant
magical merchant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.
magical merchant.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.

magical misfit.name: Magical Misfit
magical misfit.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat.
magical misfit.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat.

mammoth herder.name: Mammoth Herder
mammoth herder.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herding Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.
mammoth herder.source: Quest for the Frozen Flame Player's Guide pg. 8
mammoth herder.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Herding Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.

mammoth speaker.name: Mammoth Speaker
mammoth speaker.text: You have learned the secrets of taming the mighty mammoths and other megafauna of the far north. Perhaps these talents are a part of your people’s traditional customs, or perhaps you sought out these massive animals of your own accord. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Animal Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.
mammoth speaker.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Animal Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.

mana wastes refugee.name: Mana Wastes Refugee
mana wastes refugee.text: Exposure to the corrupting influence of the Mana Wastes’ strange energies has warped your inner essence, resulting in unpredictable interactions with magic items and more than a little know-how about surviving under bizarre and adverse natural conditions. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Wilderness Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat.
mana wastes refugee.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Wilderness Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat.

mantis scion.name: Mantis Scion
mantis scion.text: At least one of your parents is a member of the notorious Red Mantis assassins, merciless killers for hire who rarely fail to claim their marks. Whether on purpose or by simple exposure, you were trained from a young age in the art of stalking and killing people. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Assassin Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Stealth.
mantis scion.details: Whether on purpose or by simple exposure, you were trained from a young age in the art of stalking and killing people. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Assassin Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Stealth.

market runner.name: Market Runner
market runner.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Otari Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
market runner.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Otari Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

martial disciple.name: Martial Disciple
martial disciple.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Athletics skill, as well as the Warfare Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Cat Fall if you chose Acrobatics or Quick Jump if you chose Athletics.
martial disciple.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Athletics skill, as well as the Warfare Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Cat Fall if you chose Acrobatics or Quick Jump if you chose Athletics.

martial musician.name: Martial Musician
martial musician.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.
martial musician.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.
mechanic.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

mechanical symbiosis.name: Mechanical Symbiosis
mechanical symbiosis.text: You have studied and searched for information on these rare, crab-like machines, leaving you an expert in the binding of elemental spirits or mortal souls to mechanical objects. Though you have several theories on what the symbiotic entity might be, you have no definitive answers—this may be why you're adventuring in the first place, or perhaps you've made a deal with someone to get it removed. The entity might talk to you periodically, or it might only speak when it wants you to do something in particular or finds the two of you in danger. You and the GM should decide on the entity's motivations, or if the motivations should be a secret known only to the GM. Choose two ability boosts.
mechanical symbiosis.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill and an additional skill in which the clockwork entity is well-versed, determined by the GM.

medicinal clocksmith.name: Medicinal Clocksmith
medicinal clocksmith.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Risky Surgery skill feat.
medicinal clocksmith.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Risky Surgery skill feat.

megafauna hunter.name: Megafauna Hunter
megafauna hunter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.
megafauna hunter.source: Quest for the Frozen Flame Player's Guide pg. 8
megafauna hunter.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.

menagerie dung sweeper.name: Menagerie Dung Sweeper
menagerie dung sweeper.text: Whether you washed warrior beasts below the Irorium’s arena floor or tended to the mutated animals of a Puddle sideshow, you are experienced with all manner of weird wildlife. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Animal Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.
menagerie dung sweeper.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Animal Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.

merabite prodigy.name: Merabite Prodigy
merabite prodigy.text: Even in a city renowned for its alchemy, you were able to rise above the competition. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Alchemical Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat with alchemy.
merabite prodigy.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Alchemical Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat with alchemy.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat.
merchant.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Bargain Hunter skill feat.

militia member.name: Militia Member
militia member.text: Sandpoint’s come to rely on two additional forms of defense as a result, and the first of those is one you’ve belonged to since you could properly wield a weapon—the Sandpoint Militia. You grew up on Sandpoint’s waterfront, perhaps the child of a fisher, sailor, or shipwright, and whether or not your parents approved of your choice to turn away from the sea to join the militia, you know it was the right choice. As a militia member, your duties were to help patrol the city, report suspicious activities, and help to deal with minor events or petty crimes before they have a chance to escalate.
militia member.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 13
militia member.details: You’re trained in the Athletics skill and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

miner.name: Miner
miner.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Mining Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with underground terrain.
miner.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Mining Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with underground terrain.

missionary.name: Missionary
missionary.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
missionary.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

molthuni mercenary.name: Molthuni Mercenary
molthuni mercenary.text: Whether you sought citizenship or simply needed a steady paycheck, you spent some of your time as a paid mercenary in the armed forces of Molthune, where you fought against Molthune’s enemies such as Nirmathas or the Ironfang Legion. Alternatively, you might have worked at sea, protecting Molthune’s military and trading ships against pirates on Lake Encarthan. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Mercenary Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
molthuni mercenary.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Mercenary Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

money counter.name: Money Counter
money counter.text: The Tax Collectors Union is unaware of your petty theft, and you remain in good standing with them. Your party gains 1 Reputation Point with the Tax Collectors Union at the start of the campaign. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Society or the Thievery skill, as well as the Accounting Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Eye for Numbers if you chose Society or Subtle Theft if you chose Thievery.
money counter.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Society or the Thievery skill, as well as the Accounting Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Eye for Numbers if you chose Society or Subtle Theft if you chose Thievery.

moot guard.name: Moot Guard
moot guard.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
moot guard.source: Wardens of Wildwood Players Guide pg. 7
moot guard.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

mortuarium survivor.name: Mortuarium Survivor
mortuarium survivor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Necromancy Lore skill. You gain the Inured to Death reaction
mortuarium survivor.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Necromancy Lore skill.

mount spire guide.name: Mount Spire Guide
mount spire guide.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Mountain Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with mountain terrain.
mount spire guide.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Mountain Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with mountain terrain.

muesello's student.name: Muesello's Student
muesello's student.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat. Additionally, when Muesello is present during your mission briefings, he takes some time to catch up with you and discuss your mission. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
muesello's student.details: You trained under Venture-Captain Muesello of the Oppara Lodge in Taldor. You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Crafter's Appraisal skill feat.

musical prodigy.name: Musical Prodigy
musical prodigy.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Music Lore skill. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.
musical prodigy.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Music Lore skill. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.

mystery adept.name: Mystery Adept
mystery adept.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
mystery adept.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.

mystic seer.name: Mystic Seer
mystic seer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Scam Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
mystic seer.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Scam Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.

mystic tutor.name: Mystic Tutor
mystic tutor.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be Intelligence or Wisdom and one is a free ability boost. Your innate magical trait is arcane or occult. You're trained in either Arcana or Occultism, depending on your innate magical trait, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
mystic tutor.details: You're trained in either Arcana or Occultism, depending on your innate magical trait, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

necromancer's apprentice.name: Necromancer's Apprentice
necromancer's apprentice.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Necromancy Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.
necromancer's apprentice.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Necromancy Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.

newcomer.name: Newcomer
newcomer.text: While your reasons for coming to Sandpoint are up to you, they should have something to do with your curiosity about the town, the Lost Coast, ancient Thassilon, the history of the Varisian lifestyle, or anything that might draw you to the region. You don’t yet own your own home in town and aren’t sure you ever will, since once you’ve completed your research you might not intend to stay in Sandpoint. You might have accepted an offer from a Scarnetti ally who had a room to let in their home (or nearby shed), could be paying for a room at one of the town’s inns, or might be relying on one of your few non-Scarnetti friends in town for a place to stay.
newcomer.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 14
newcomer.details: You’re trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Library Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat—the lore you choose represents the interest and focus of study that drew you to the region.

newcomer in need.name: Newcomer in Need
newcomer in need.text: Maybe you need the prize money to pay for a relative's expensive operation or to free your family from debt to Golden League gangsters. Or maybe there's a particular prize in Hao Jin's vault that could literally save your life—an amulet you can use to flee to the farthest corners of the multiverse or even an artifact that could resurrect you if you die, just like the Ruby Phoenix. The tough circumstances of your upbringing in one of Goka's more downtrodden neighborhoods—such as industrial Oldtown, the slums of the Scales district, or even the crime-ridden undercity—taught you lessons of self-reliance and how to quickly make friends in unlikely circumstances.
newcomer in need.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Player's Guide pg. 7
newcomer in need.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Goka Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

nexian mystic.name: Nexian Mystic
nexian mystic.text: Your initiations into the Nexian mysteries and the philosophies of the Arclords of Nex grant you a preternatural comprehension of the arcane underpinnings of existence. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and a Lore skill related to one plane of your choice (other than the material plane). You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
nexian mystic.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and a Lore skill related to one plane of your choice (other than the material plane). You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.

night watch.name: Night Watch
night watch.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill and either Legal Lore or the Lore skill for your home settlement. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
night watch.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill and either Legal Lore or the Lore skill for your home settlement. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

nirmathi guerrilla.name: Nirmathi Guerrilla
nirmathi guerrilla.text: Woodcraft comes naturally to you, and you have learned how to use the forest to your tactical advantage against superior forces in skirmishes against the Molthuni army or the Ironfang Legion. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Forest Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker (underbrush) skill feat.
nirmathi guerrilla.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Forest Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker (underbrush) skill feat.

noble.name: Noble
noble.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill or Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.
noble.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill or Heraldry Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.

nocturnal navigator.name: Nocturnal Navigator
nocturnal navigator.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Survival. Whenever you can clearly identify the stars, if you roll a success on a check to Sense Direction or otherwise orienteer, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure at such a check, you get a failure instead.

nomad.name: Nomad
nomad.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to one terrain you traveled in (such as Desert Lore or Swamp Lore). You gain the Assurance skill feat with Survival.
nomad.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to one terrain you traveled in (such as Desert Lore or Swamp Lore). You gain the Assurance skill feat with Survival.

northland forager.name: Northland Forager
northland forager.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
northland forager.source: Quest for the Frozen Flame Player's Guide pg. 8
northland forager.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

northridge scholar.name: Northridge Scholar
northridge scholar.text: Your home is likely somewhere along the northern banks of the Ceiba River to the east of downtown Willowshore. During the Reenactment Festival, you likely helped to run some of the festivities or spent time simply sitting back to people-watch. You volunteered to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because the experience of taking part in one of the town's longest-running traditions is an honor you've always wanted to experience. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Strength, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Society skill and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore feat.
northridge scholar.source: Season of Ghosts Player's Guide pg. 12
northridge scholar.details: You're trained in the Society skill and the Academia Lore skill.

obari wanderer.name: Obari Wanderer
obari wanderer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Survival skill, as well as the Sailing Lore skill. If you choose Acrobatics, you gain the Cat Fall skill feat. If you choose Survival, you gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat (aquatic or forest terrain is recommended).
obari wanderer.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Survival skill, as well as the Sailing Lore skill. If you choose Acrobatics, you gain the Cat Fall skill feat. If you choose Survival, you gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat (aquatic or forest terrain is recommended).

occult librarian.name: Occult Librarian
occult librarian.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.
occult librarian.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.

ocean diver.name: Ocean Diver
ocean diver.text: You’re one of the sea people, the divers who inhabit the rough shorelines. Diving into foreign depths with neither magic nor air reserves, it’s your job to haul up seafood to feed your communities. Tourists come to watch you, listening to your whistles and songs as they crane their necks to catch sight of the pearls you sometimes bring to the surface. They might call you mermaids, but you know better. You’ve seen the true folk of the sea as you’ve gathered shellfish in your nets. You know to wear white to ward off sharks and worse. When adventure or treasure is found in the waves, you’re one of the few who could possibly deal with it. Choose two attribute boosts.
ocean diver.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Ocean Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.

oenopion ooze-tender.name: Oenopion Ooze-Tender
oenopion ooze-tender.text: Your apprenticeship in one of Oenopion’s unorthodox arcane and alchemical academies instilled in you a deep reservoir of mostly reliable esoteric knowledge, not to mention a deep resentment born of countless hours spent mucking ooze pens and feeding helpless creatures to ravenous, belching jellies and gelatinous puddings. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Ooze Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
oenopion ooze-tender.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Ooze Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

once bitten.name: Once Bitten
once bitten.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
once bitten.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

once possessed.name: Once Possessed
once possessed.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and a Lore skill focused on all fiends—not just a specific family like demon, rakshasa, or sahkil. This Fiend Lore skill can be used whenever you'd need to attempt a check against any fiend In addition, the spiritual "scar tissue" you endure has left you with increased protection against such attacks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects from fiends. In addition, you gain the following reaction.
once possessed.source: Bastion of Blasphemies Player's Guide pg. 10
once possessed.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and a Lore skill focused on all fiends—not just a specific family like demon, rakshasa, or sahkil.

onyx trader.name: Onyx Trader
onyx trader.text: Oprak doesn’t share the secrets of the Onyx Vault with many, but you are one of the lucky few to be permitted into the heart of the nation. You have traveled the extradimensional paths of the Stone Roads and traded goods across a wide variety of lands. You’ve learned to step lively in foreign markets of all types. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
onyx trader.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

osirionologist.name: Osirionologist
osirionologist.text: Whether you’re a fascinated outsider or a local proud of your nation’s storied past, you’re a devoted student of Osirion’s history. You might be a traveling professor, a member of a society like the Pathfinders or the Esoteric Order of the Palatine Eye, or even a simple tomb robber cashing in on the glories of the past. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Ancient Osirion Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.
osirionologist.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Ancient Osirion Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

osprey barnraiser.name: Osprey Barnraiser
osprey barnraiser.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.
osprey barnraiser.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.

osprey fisher.name: Osprey Fisher
osprey fisher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.
osprey fisher.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

osprey scion.name: Osprey Scion
osprey scion.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Xin-Edasseril Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
osprey scion.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Xin-Edasseril Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

osprey scout.name: Osprey Scout
osprey scout.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.
osprey scout.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

osprey scribe.name: Osprey Scribe
osprey scribe.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
osprey scribe.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

osprey spellcaster.name: Osprey Spellcaster
osprey spellcaster.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill, and gain Thassilonian as a bonus language. You also gain the Quick Identification skill feat.
osprey spellcaster.details: You're trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill, and gain Thassilonian as a bonus language. You also gain the Quick Identification skill feat.

osprey warrior.name: Osprey Warrior
osprey warrior.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gorum Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
osprey warrior.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gorum Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

otherworldly mission.name: Otherworldly Mission
otherworldly mission.text: You should work with your GM on how to handle the truth of your character's backstory or leave it to the GM to decide in secret. Is this call to action a message from the character's own mind, are they being manipulated by some manner of supernatural entity, or are they actually getting marching orders from one of the deities of the setting? Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Religion. Once per adventure, you can ask the voice you believe to be a deity for orders and get some kind of instruction—you never get any kind of explanation, simply a command to go somewhere or do something.

out-of-towner.name: Out-of-Towner
out-of-towner.text: You’re excited to meet new people and cultures, and answering the Call for Heroes seems to be an interesting way to do so. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill thematically associated with the members of the ancestry you grew up with: Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goblin, or Halfling. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
out-of-towner.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 5
out-of-towner.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill thematically associated with the members of the ancestry you grew up with: Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goblin, or Halfling. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

outrider.name: Outrider
outrider.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plains Lore skill. You gain the Express Rider skill feat.
outrider.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plains Lore skill. You gain the Express Rider skill feat.

outskirt dweller.name: Outskirt Dweller
outskirt dweller.text: Your home is on the outskirts of Willowshore and might not even be represented by an actual building on the map. With the GM's permission, you might even dwell in a small building further out in the Willowshore hinterlands, but no further than a couple of miles from town. During the Reenactment Festival, you likely showed up late and weren't intending to stay for long, but your friends and allies (the other PCs) convinced you to stick around.
outskirt dweller.source: Season of Ghosts Player's Guide pg. 12
outskirt dweller.details: You're trained in the Nature skill and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise (forest) skill feat.

overburn emissary.name: Overburn Emissary
overburn emissary.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill and a Lore skill related to a specific settlement in the Darklands, such as Lattiskar (a cosmopolitan Nar-Voth city ruled by ayindilar elves) or Sverenagati (the capital city of the serpentfolk on Sekamina). You gain the Multilingual skill feat but must select Sakvroth as one of the languages you learn. In addition, you treat the following rare languages as uncommon instead: Munavri, Orvian, Surki.
overburn emissary.details: You're trained in the Society skill and a Lore skill related to a specific settlement in the Darklands, such as Lattiskar (a cosmopolitan Nar-Voth city ruled by ayindilar elves) or Sverenagati (the capital city of the serpentfolk on Sekamina). You gain the Multilingual skill feat but must select Sakvroth as one of the languages you learn.

ozem experience.name: Ozem Experience

ozem experience.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat.

party scholar.name: Party Scholar
party scholar.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Alcohol Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
party scholar.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Alcohol Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

pathfinder hopeful.name: Pathfinder Hopeful
pathfinder hopeful.text: You’ve long wanted to join the adventurous Pathfinder Society. You have taken up the dangerous life of an adventurer in hopes of earning a spot among the Pathfinders. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Pathfinder Society Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.
pathfinder hopeful.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Pathfinder Society Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.

pathfinder recruiter.name: Pathfinder Recruiter
pathfinder recruiter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill related to one city you've visited often. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
pathfinder recruiter.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 8
pathfinder recruiter.details: Whether you’re professionally trained to seek new recruits or the Society’s own scouts identified your potential and raised you from childhood, you’re committed to expanding the Society’s roster. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill related to one city you've visited often. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

perfection seeker.name: Perfection Seeker
perfection seeker.text: You aspire to perfect your body and mind in the tradition of Jalmeray’s Houses of Perfection, honing your acrobatic skills and mental faculties in preparation for a lifetime pushing the edge of what most consider possible. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.
perfection seeker.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim
pilgrim.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Lore skill for your patron deity. You gain the Pilgrim's Token skill feat.
pilgrim.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Lore skill for your patron deity. You gain the Pilgrim's Token skill feat.

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in one of your choice of the Medicine, Society, or Survival skills, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.
pillar.details: You're trained in one of your choice of the Medicine, Society, or Survival skills, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat.

plague doctor.name: Plague Doctor
plague doctor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Inoculation skill feat.
plague doctor.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Inoculation skill feat.

planar migrant.name: Planar Migrant
planar migrant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill and one of the following lore skills: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore. You gain the Hefty Hauler and Prescient Planner skill feats.
planar migrant.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill and one of the following lore skills: Plane of Air Lore, Plane of Earth Lore, Plane of Fire Lore, Plane of Metal Lore, Plane of Water Lore, or Plane of Wood Lore.

plant whisperer.name: Plant Whisperer
plant whisperer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plant Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.
plant whisperer.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Plant Lore skill. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat.

political scion.name: Political Scion
political scion.text: Your decision to transfer to the Edgewatch has rubbed your traditionalist family the wrong way, and they've cut off the financial aid they've provided you your whole life. But you don't care—you know you're doing the right thing by taking on the rough jobs of a low-ranking guard, and you're ready to shine based on your own merits, not those of your lofty kin. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and Legal Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to interact with members of Absalom's political establishment. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
political scion.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 8
political scion.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and Legal Lore. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

portal scholar.name: Portal Scholar
portal scholar.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat, and also gain the following reaction.
portal scholar.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill and the Architecture Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat, and also gain the following reaction.

post guard of all trade.name: Post Guard of All Trade
post guard of all trade.text: For all the excitement of guarding Absalom's Postern Gate, the Post Guard wasn't really the right fit for someone as distractible as yourself, so your boss put in a “promotion” for you to transfer to the newly formed Edgewatch. You're all for the reassignment, since it will put you smack in the middle of the most entertaining and diverse gathering of the century, the Radiant Festival. Choose two ability boosts.
