One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, a Lore skill of your choice, and you gain a bonus language.
post guard of all trade.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 8
post guard of all trade.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, a Lore skill of your choice, and you gain a bonus language. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

press-ganged (g&g).name: Press-Ganged (G&G)
press-ganged (g&g).text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Armor Assist skill feat.
press-ganged (g&g).details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Armor Assist skill feat.

press-ganged (lowg).name: Press-Ganged (LOWG)
press-ganged (lowg).text: You were forced into service as a sailor against your will. Perhaps you were punished for a crime, were drafted into military service, are repaying a debt, or simply were abducted. Though you were initially trained as a simple deckhand, you may have subsequently studied a trade under one of the vessel's specialists. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
press-ganged (lowg).details: Though you were initially trained as a simple deckhand, you may have subsequently studied a trade under one of the vessel's specialists. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

printer.name: Printer
printer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
printer.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

prisoner.name: Prisoner
prisoner.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.
prisoner.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

prisoner of war.name: Prisoner of War
prisoner of war.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, as well as the Warfare Lore skill. When you do your daily preparations, you can Craft a single level-0 item of light Bulk or less and worth no more than 1 gp, provided you have even the most basic raw materials on hand. Items you make in this way are shoddy, but you've found that keeping your hands busy helps you order your thoughts. Any day you use this ability to Craft an item, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects for 24 hours.
prisoner of war.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, as well as the Warfare Lore skill.

professional letter writer.name: Professional Letter Writer
professional letter writer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in Scribing Lore. You gain one skill feat of your choice between the Specialty Crafting or Multilingual skill feat. During your daily preparations, you can choose one additional language that you know. You can change this language the next time you make your daily preparations.
professional letter writer.details: You're trained in Scribing Lore. You gain one skill feat of your choice between the Specialty Crafting or Multilingual skill feat.

propaganda promoter.name: Propaganda Promoter
propaganda promoter.text: You are still well-regarded by the Celebrants. Your party gains 1 Reputation Point with the Celebrants at the start of the campaign. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Performance skill, as well as the Urgathoa Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Steady Balance if you chose Acrobatics or Impressive Performance if you chose Performance.
propaganda promoter.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Acrobatics or the Performance skill, as well as the Urgathoa Lore skill. You gain a skill feat: Steady Balance if you chose Acrobatics or Impressive Performance if you chose Performance.

puddles carny.name: Puddles Carny
puddles carny.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Art Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
puddles carny.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Art Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

purveyor of the bizarre.name: Purveyor of the Bizarre
purveyor of the bizarre.text: Whether in Katapesh or one of the bustling markets along the Path of Salt, you’ve spent enough time buying and selling ancient or unusual items to give you an instinctive ability to quickly sort valuable trinkets from worthless baubles. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.
purveyor of the bizarre.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.

pyre tender.name: Pyre Tender
pyre tender.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Funeral Lore skill. You gain the Alchemical Crafting skill feat.
pyre tender.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Funeral Lore skill. You gain the Alchemical Crafting skill feat.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
quartermaster.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

quick.name: Quick
quick.text: Staying alive among the scheming, ravenous undead of Geb required a deep knowledge of their motivations, capabilities, and weaknesses. More often than not, it also required the ability to weave alibis and life-preserving half-truths capable of swaying a stilled heart. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.
quick.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Undead Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

quick refugee.name: Quick Refugee
quick refugee.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Undead Lore skill. When you Hide or Sneak successfully, you are also hidden or concealed from undeads' lifesense and other special precise senses the undead possess.
quick refugee.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Undead Lore skill.

radiant oath.name: Radiant Oath
radiant oath.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Spirit Lore skill. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.
radiant oath.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 10
radiant oath.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Spirit Lore skill. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.

raised by belief.name: Raised by Belief
raised by belief.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to an attribute specified in your deity’s Divine Attribute and the other is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in your deity’s associated skill, and you gain Assurance with that skill. You gain a Lore skill with a subcategory associated with your deity (Abadar Lore, for instance).
raised by belief.details: You’re trained in your deity’s associated skill, and you gain Assurance with that skill.

ratted-out gun runner.name: Ratted-Out Gun Runner
ratted-out gun runner.text: One day, a corrupt financier named Ambrost Mugland—a true crook if there ever was one—approached you, demanding a cut of your business. When you refused, he put in a word with the shieldmarshals that you'd be a certain somewhere at a certain time with a certain large quantity of illegally obtained firearms. Even though you escaped arrest, your identity was compromised, and your old accomplices have all turned their backs on you. Your gun-running days are clearly over. Now, you're just running. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Firearm Lore skill.
ratted-out gun runner.source: Outlaws of Alkenstar Player's Guide pg. 12
ratted-out gun runner.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Firearm Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

ravounelian civil servant.name: Ravounelian Civil Servant
ravounelian civil servant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Ravounel Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
ravounelian civil servant.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Ravounel Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

razmiran faithful.name: Razmiran Faithful
razmiran faithful.text: You serve a living god who rules upon the face of Golarion, and this gives your actions a divine mandate not to be trifled with. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Razmir Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
razmiran faithful.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Razmir Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

reborn soul.name: Reborn Soul
reborn soul.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You become trained in two Lore skills, which you and your GM choose from Lore skills associated with your past life. At 3rd level, 7th level, and 15th level, you receive skill increases, which you can apply only to these Lore skills. In certain situations analogous to your past life, fragments of memories resurface, potentially helping or distracting you. The GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks with either of these Lore skills or on other skill checks that echo your past life.
reborn soul.details: You become trained in two Lore skills, which you and your GM choose from Lore skills associated with your past life.

reclaimed.name: Reclaimed
reclaimed.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Crimson Reclaimers Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
reclaimed.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Crimson Reclaimers Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

reclaimed investigator.name: Reclaimed Investigator
reclaimed investigator.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Crimson Reclaimers Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.
reclaimed investigator.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Crimson Reclaimers Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

refugee.name: Refugee
refugee.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill related to the settlement you came from. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
refugee.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and a Lore skill related to the settlement you came from. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

refugee (fop).name: Refugee (FoP)
refugee (fop).text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
refugee (fop).details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

reincarnated sekmin.name: Reincarnated Sekmin
reincarnated sekmin.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Athletics skill, as well as the Sekmin Lore skill. Serpentfolk are a common creature to you; as a result, the DC of any skill check you make to Recall Knowledge about serpentfolk isn't increased because serpentfolk are uncommon. In addition, you gain the Sibilant Whispers action.
reincarnated sekmin.details: You're trained in your choice of the Arcana or Athletics skill, as well as the Sekmin Lore skill.

relentless dedication.name: Relentless Dedication
relentless dedication.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Warfare Lore skill, and you gain the Canny Acumen feat.
relentless dedication.details: You're trained in the Warfare Lore skill, and you gain the Canny Acumen feat.

remittance agent.name: Remittance Agent
remittance agent.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill or Mercenary Lore. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
remittance agent.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill or Mercenary Lore. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

report runner.name: Report Runner
report runner.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Stabling Lore skill. You gain the Express Rider skill feat.
report runner.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Stabling Lore skill. You gain the Express Rider skill feat.

reputation seeker.name: Reputation Seeker
reputation seeker.text: You’ve decided that joining an adventuring group would be the best way to secure aid in your quest to build your own reputation, and are attending the Call for Heroes to find such allies. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Darklands, Desert, or Jungle Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat (underground if you have Darklands Lore, desert if you have Desert Lore, or forest if you have Jungle Lore).
reputation seeker.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 5
reputation seeker.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Darklands, Desert, or Jungle Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat (underground if you have Darklands Lore, desert if you have Desert Lore, or forest if you have Jungle Lore).

respected mentor.name: Respected Mentor
respected mentor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Academia Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.
respected mentor.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Academia Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

returned.name: Returned
returned.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You gain the Diehard feat and the Additional Lore feat for Boneyard Lore.

returning descendant.name: Returning Descendant
returning descendant.text: You’ve decided to respond to the Call for Heroes to follow in your ancestor’s footsteps, either to honor their memory or accomplish the great deeds they did not. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.
returning descendant.source: Age of Ashes Player's Guide pg. 5
returning descendant.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.

revenant.name: Revenant
revenant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Religion and Boneyard Lore. You’re still alive, not undead, but you have the void healing ability, which means you’re harmed by vitality damage and healed by void effects as if you were undead.
revenant.details: You’re trained in Religion and Boneyard Lore.

rigger.name: Rigger
rigger.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Circus Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.
rigger.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Circus Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

rivethun adherent.name: Rivethun Adherent
rivethun adherent.text: You have spent time learning the practices and traditions of the ancient Rivethun dwarven shamans and can recognize all sorts of magic. You may have chosen your own road since then, or you may remain an adherent of the philosophy. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Spirit Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
rivethun adherent.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Spirit Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

root worker.name: Root Worker
root worker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Root Magic skill feat.
root worker.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Root Magic skill feat.

rostland partisan.name: Rostland Partisan
rostland partisan.text: You grew up among the southern houses of Brevoy in old Rostland. You’re accustomed to arguing from a position of underappreciated worth. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.
rostland partisan.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

rostlander.name: Rostlander
rostlander.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
rostlander.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

royalty.name: Royalty
royalty.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You are trained in Society. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat and can influence commoners in your family's territory, as well as nobility anywhere. If you later gain the Leverage Connections skill feat you automatically have common and noble connections within any community in your royal family's territory and have noble connections in large communities outside your territory.
royalty.details: You are trained in Society. You gain the Courtly Graces skill feat and can influence commoners in your family's territory, as well as nobility anywhere. If you later gain the Leverage Connections skill feat you automatically have common and noble connections within any community in your royal family's territory and have noble connections in large communities outside your territory.

ruby phoenix enthusiast.name: Ruby Phoenix Enthusiast
ruby phoenix enthusiast.text: Named for the legendary sorcerer Hao Jin, the Ruby Phoenix Tournament occurs once every 10 years in Goka and attracts extraordinary talent from across the world. You might have begun training for the tournament but never participated, or perhaps you entered the tournament only to be defeated by (and inspired to join) the Pathfinder Society. Either way, your dedicated training prepares you for the rigors of the adventuring lifestyle. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.
ruby phoenix enthusiast.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

ruby phoenix fanatic.name: Ruby Phoenix Fanatic
ruby phoenix fanatic.text: In order to get as close to Hao Jin as possible, you've researched everything there is to know about the Ruby Phoenix's home, her planar escapades, and her competition. You've also trained your body to prove yourself a worthy champion. When Hao Jin's committee invited you and some friends to take part in the tournament's prequalifier, you just about fainted from excitement. Is your dream of meeting the Ruby Phoenix about to come true? As long as you win enough matches to get into the actual tournament, it just might! Just try not to act too star-struck when you finally get a chance to talk to her, okay? Choose two attribute boosts.
ruby phoenix fanatic.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Player's Guide pg. 7
ruby phoenix fanatic.details: You've also trained your body to prove yourself a worthy champion. You're trained in the Axis Lore, Gladiatorial Lore, and Goka Lore skills., and a Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

ruin delver.name: Ruin Delver
ruin delver.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Roseguard Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.
ruin delver.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Roseguard Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

runaway noble.name: Runaway Noble
runaway noble.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill or Heraldry Lore. You gain the Bon Mot skill feat.
runaway noble.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill or Heraldry Lore. You gain the Bon Mot skill feat.

runelord researcher.name: Runelord Researcher
runelord researcher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and the other is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Arcana and Academia Lore. When you Recall Knowledge about runelords or ancient Thassilon, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. You automatically recognize the name and time of rule of any runelord you encounter or see an accurate representation of (such as a painting or statue). In addition, during your daily preparations, you can choose one of the following schools of Thassilonian rune magic to focus your mind on, gaining a +1 status bonus to saving throws against the listed effect for the next 8 hours.
runelord researcher.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 16
runelord researcher.details: You’re trained in Arcana and Academia Lore.

runelord scholar.name: Runelord Scholar
runelord scholar.text: As a local, you’ve been equally inspired and intrigued by stories of adventurers who explore these dangerous ruins, be they Sandpoint’s own heroes or others who have explored more distant mysteries like Hollow Mountain, the Lady’s Light, or Guiltspur. You hope one day to rediscover a Thassilonian ruin that’s not yet been fully explored, but you also know that such pursuits are dangerous. Here in Sandpoint, a group called the Runewatchers has dedicated their resources to the research of Thassilon and their runelords, but while you’ve spoken with them many times, they’ve yet to fully accept you into their circle. And so you sought out the adventuring party you now belong to.
runelord scholar.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 14
runelord scholar.details: You’re trained in the Arcana skill and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat, but one of the languages you gain from this feat must be Thassilonian.

runelord survivor.name: Runelord Survivor
runelord survivor.text: If you played through a previous runelord-themed Adventure Path, with your GM’s aid you could be one of the NPCs who featured in one of those adventures and watched in fear as that campaign’s PCs did the best they could to oppose the runelords. You may or may not blame those PCs for the tragedy that befell you, but you always know it was one of the runelords themselves who was the ultimate cause of your pain. For some time—perhaps even years— after your brush with a runelord nearly killed you, you were forced to scavenge to survive in the wilds, perhaps in hiding or possibly because you had no other choice.
runelord survivor.source: Revenge of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 16
runelord survivor.details: You’re trained in Nature and Warfare Lore.

runner.name: Runner
runner.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill for the city in which you were a messenger. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat.
runner.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill for the city in which you were a messenger. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Concealing Legerdemain skill feat.
saboteur.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Concealing Legerdemain skill feat.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.
sailor.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat.

sally guard neophyte.name: Sally Guard Neophyte
sally guard neophyte.text: Biting your lip in shame, you took the Edgewatch reassignment in order to gain the experience necessary to go back to your home district with your head held high. You'll prove them wrong, one way or another, and show everyone that you can protect the ones you hold most dear. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Nature skill and your choice of Hunting Lore or Stabling Lore. You start out with a riding horse, as well as a suit of shoddy half-plate armor, a shoddy longsword, and a shoddy lance (see here for the rules on shoddy items).
sally guard neophyte.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 8
sally guard neophyte.details: You're trained in the Nature skill and your choice of Hunting Lore or Stabling Lore.

saloon entertainer.name: Saloon Entertainer
saloon entertainer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.
saloon entertainer.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.

sandswept survivor.name: Sandswept Survivor
sandswept survivor.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to a specific type of undead, such as Mummy Lore or Zombie Lore. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with underground terrain. Additionally, when you receive a mission briefing at the Sandswept Hall, your familiarity with its history and staff grants further insight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your checks to Gather Information or Recall Knowledge during the Getting Started segment of such adventures. Be sure to remind your GM that you have a relevant background.
sandswept survivor.details: You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to a specific type of undead, such as Mummy Lore or Zombie Lore. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with underground terrain.

sarkorian reclaimer.name: Sarkorian Reclaimer
sarkorian reclaimer.text: Whether you trace your heritage to lost Sarkoris or are a crusader trying to atone for past fanatics’ wrongs, you seek to liberate the Sarkorian homeland from the demons who have defiled it. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Abyssal Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
sarkorian reclaimer.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Abyssal Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

sarkorian survivor.name: Sarkorian Survivor
sarkorian survivor.text: The devastation and carnage of the Worldwound were nearly complete, but you somehow managed to survive it. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Sarkorian History Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
sarkorian survivor.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Sarkorian History Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

saved by clockwork.name: Saved by Clockwork
saved by clockwork.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill. Every day you must perform 10 minutes of maintenance and wind up your clockwork parts, or you risk failure of the components, with consequences depending on what you replaced (determined by you and the GM). Your clockwork components allow you to react to danger with alacrity. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
saved by clockwork.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill.

savior of air.name: Savior of Air
savior of air.text: Upon securing the Untouchable Opal, an artifact of extraordinary power, the Pathfinder Society endeavored to free the benevolent demigod Ranginori, who was trapped within the virtually unbreakable prison. You might have joined the Pathfinder Society in its expeditions to the Elemental Planes, or you might have lived on one of those planes before learning of the Society from these Pathfinder agents. You are no stranger to navigating precarious terrain as a result. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.
savior of air.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Elemental Lords Lore skill or a Lore skill related either to one of the Elemental Planes (such as Plane of Air Lore). You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

scarnetti-connected.name: Scarnetti-Connected
scarnetti-connected.text: Your relationship with the Scarnettis has ensured you’re part of all of this, like it or not. You don’t bear the family name, but you might be a distant relation from Riddleport or Magnimar hoping for a new chance at life. You could be a petty criminal whose fines were paid by the Scarnettis in return for a promise of service for several months or years. You might even admire the family’s tenacity and see in the Scarnettis a chance for your own fortune.
scarnetti-connected.source: Pathfinder Seven Dooms for Sandpoint Player’s Guide pg. 15
scarnetti-connected.details: You’re trained in the Intimidation skill and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill for the settlement you grew up scavenging in. You gain the Forager skill feat.
scavenger.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill for the settlement you grew up scavenging in. You gain the Forager skill feat.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill.
scholar.details: You’re trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill.

scholar of battlefields.name: Scholar of Battlefields
scholar of battlefields.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Relentless Assault action. Relentless Assault (fortune) Frequency once per day; Trigger A creature would succeed or critically succeed at a saving throw against the offensive ability of a troop you command; Effect With an encouraging command, you direct your troop to make a few additional attacks. The triggering creature rerolls its saving throw and uses the worse result
scholar of battlefields.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Warfare Lore skill.

scholar of the ancients.name: Scholar of the Ancients
scholar of the ancients.text: You're fascinated by the lost Azlanti Empire and have dedicated yourself to seeking out and studying every broken artifact or scrap of knowledge that remains, whether as an academic pursuit or simply for the joy of treasure hunting. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Azlant Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.
scholar of the ancients.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Azlant Lore skill. You gain the Quick Identification skill feat.

scholar of the sky key.name: Scholar of the Sky Key
scholar of the sky key.text: The unfamiliar technology of Numeria’s Silver Mount still baffles Society scholars, yet you are one of the innovators who discovered how to operate a handful of these futuristic tools—possibly after surviving more than a few explosions. The Society might have recruited you for your esoteric abilities, or you might have sought out the Society’s protection in escaping the covetously vile Technic League. Even if your understanding of advanced technology is imperfect, your hard-learned lessons are invaluable in deciphering and repairing gear. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.
scholar of the sky key.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

school medic.name: School Medic
school medic.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Academia Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
school medic.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Academia Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

scion of slayers.name: Scion of Slayers
scion of slayers.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Undead Lore skill. You can cast disrupt undead as an innate divine cantrip. You can use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for this innate spell.
scion of slayers.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Undead Lore skill.

scout.name: Scout
scout.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to one terrain you scouted in (such as Forest Lore or Cavern Lore). You gain the Forager skill feat.
scout.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and a Lore skill related to one terrain you scouted in (such as Forest Lore or Cavern Lore). You gain the Forager skill feat.

second chance champion.name: Second Chance Champion
second chance champion.text: Now, after training for a decade to ensure you don't repeat any of your prior mistakes, you've joined forces with a team of fellow fighters in order to maximize your odds of making it all the way to the finals. Whatever happened before, you've vowed to return to the ring in Goka for an epic rematch, and this time you're not walking out until you've been named Ruby Phoenix Champion. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.
second chance champion.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Player's Guide pg. 7
second chance champion.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

secret scion.name: Secret Scion
secret scion.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Hellish Impression reaction. Hellish Impression Trigger You fail a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression; Frequency once per day; Effect You cast 1st-rank charm as a divine innate spell on the target of the triggering action.
secret scion.details: You're trained in the Devil Lore skill.

secular medic.name: Secular Medic
secular medic.text: You’re from Rahadoum, where the Laws of Mortality taught you to reject the gods, yet you’ve seen firsthand how dangerous it can be to go without healing magic. As a result, you’ve thrown yourself into the study of medicine, so you can save lives without saving souls. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Anatomy Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.
secular medic.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Anatomy Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

seer of the dead.name: Seer of the Dead
seer of the dead.text: You gain one ability boost. It must be to Constitution or Wisdom. You're trained in Religion and Undead Lore. You gain the effects of the spirit sense spell at all times.
seer of the dead.details: You're trained in Religion and Undead Lore.

self-made.name: Self-Made
self-made.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill related to how you've paved your own way through the world You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
self-made.source: Triumph of the Tusk Player's Guide pg. 10
self-made.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and a Lore skill related to how you've paved your own way through the world You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

senghor sailor.name: Senghor Sailor
senghor sailor.text: As an experienced sailor from Senghor, you know that the only thing saving you from disaster on the high seas is a properly maintained ship. You know boat-building inside and out and you can quickly cobble together a solution in the event that something breaks. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.
senghor sailor.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sailing Lore skill. You gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

sense of belonging.name: Sense of Belonging
sense of belonging.text: Your deviant abilities are of either the flicker or the wraith classification. If you choose flicker, you gain the Sonic Dash deviant feat. If you choose wraith, you gain the Eerie Flicker deviant feat. As a quirk, whenever you use a deviant ability, plants around you spontaneously bloom and then wilt, as if rapidly aging. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
sense of belonging.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

sentinel reflectance.name: Sentinel Reflectance
sentinel reflectance.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Shining Sentinels Lore skill. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.
sentinel reflectance.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Shining Sentinels Lore skill. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.

servant.name: Servant
servant.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Read Lips skill feat.
servant.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the Read Lips skill feat.

sewer dragon.name: Sewer Dragon
sewer dragon.text: You are one of the Sewer Dragons, born in Absalom's sewers, strengthened by a life defending your territory. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Kobold Lore skill. You gain the Snare Crafting skill feat.
sewer dragon.source: PFS Quest #10: The Broken Scales pg. 16
sewer dragon.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Kobold Lore skill. You gain the Snare Crafting skill feat.

shadow haunted.name: Shadow Haunted
shadow haunted.text: You are from Nidal, and regardless of your personal values, Zon-Kuthon has a claim on your soul due to an ancient pact. The Midnight Lord’s unsettling influence is bred deep into your bones. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Shadow Plane Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
shadow haunted.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Shadow Plane Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

shadow lodge defector.name: Shadow Lodge Defector
shadow lodge defector.text: You were among the Pathfinders recruited by the devious Shadow Lodge, lured in by promises of wealth, reform, justice, or revenge. You might have fought against the Society’s loyal agents, helped sabotage the Pathfinders’ reputation in distant countries, or even infiltrated the far-flung lodges as a spy. You’ve since made peace with and rejoined the Pathfinder Society, yet the underhanded reflexes and skills you learned are hard to forget. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.
shadow lodge defector.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

shadow war survivor.name: Shadow War Survivor
shadow war survivor.text: Countless factions have fought for influence in Absalom for millennia, and for decades these groups worked through the Pathfinder Society to better control the City at the Center of the World. Perhaps you were ones of these agents who clashed with other operatives during the so-called Shadow War. Or you might have been an unintended victim of these clandestine clashes, inspiring you to join the Society and stop the conflict from within. Whatever the reason, navigating the Shadow War has left you politically savvy and informed. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Absalom Lore skill.
shadow war survivor.details: You're trained in the Society skill, and the Absalom Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

shadowcaller outcast.name: Shadowcaller Outcast
shadowcaller outcast.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Netherworld Lore skill or Nidal Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
shadowcaller outcast.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Netherworld Lore skill or Nidal Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.

sheriff.name: Sheriff
sheriff.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.
sheriff.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

shielded fortune.name: Shielded Fortune
shielded fortune.text: This background is associated with the suit of Shields. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution, and one is a free ability boost. You gain the Toughness general feat and also gain the following free action. Fated Not to Die (fortune) Trigger You are dying; Frequency once per day; Effect Draw a harrow card, and you automatically lose the dying condition, though you remain unconscious at 0 Hit Points. If the card you drew was from the suit of Shields, you awaken and have an amount of Hit Points restored to you equal to 1d6 + your level.

shoanti name-bearer.name: Shoanti Name-Bearer
shoanti name-bearer.text: You are a member of a Shoanti quah and have gone through its coming of age ceremony, gaining the traditional tattoo of your quah and earning your adult name. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Quah Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.
shoanti name-bearer.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Quah Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

shory seeker.name: Shory Seeker
shory seeker.text: You’ve dedicated your life to unraveling the secrets of the ancient Shory Empire, either through meticulous research or by traveling into dangerous and distant ruins to track down long- lost artifacts. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Shory Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.
shory seeker.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Shory Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.

sideshow scion.name: Sideshow Scion
sideshow scion.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill and the Games Lore skill. You gain the Acrobatic Performer skill feat. If you have the Wildcard persona trait, you also become trained in the Circus Lore skill.
sideshow scion.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill and the Games Lore skill. You gain the Acrobatic Performer skill feat. If you have the Wildcard persona trait, you also become trained in the Circus Lore skill.

sign bound.name: Sign Bound
sign bound.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to the ability tied to your sign, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Astrology Lore. You also gain the ability to cast an occult innate spell, as determined by your sign. The frequency with which you can cast this spell is listed below; cantrips can be used as often as you wish. As normal, you cast non-cantrip innate spells at the lowest level available to that spell, such as 2nd level for speak with animals, and cantrips are heightened to half your level. Additionally, once during the prominent time for your sign (such as 12 Pharast–18 Gozran for the Bridge), you can cast your sign's spell without expending its normal use.

silk farmer.name: Silk Farmer
silk farmer.text: You’ve studied and mastered the art of sericulture. The cultivation of silkworms to produce silk is an important industry that requires an intense amount of study and care. The unchanging routine of a silk farmer could make any adventure an epic one by comparison, and perhaps that prospect led you toward adventuring. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sericulture Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.
silk farmer.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sericulture Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat.

sisterhood orphan.name: Sisterhood Orphan
sisterhood orphan.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Inflict Punishment reaction. Inflict Punishment Trigger You are hit with an unarmed Strike or a Strike with a non-reach melee weapon; Frequency once per day; Effect You twist your body so that the attacker hits a hard edge of bone or armor, injuring themselves. You deal 1d8 piercing damage to the triggering creature (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d8.
sisterhood orphan.details: You're trained in the Devil Lore skill.

sky rider.name: Sky Rider
sky rider.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Plane of Air Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.
sky rider.details: You're trained in the Acrobatics skill, and the Plane of Air Lore skill. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

sleepless suns star.name: Sleepless Suns Star
sleepless suns star.text: Your laudable performance has earned you a transfer to the newly formed Edgewatch in the Precipice Quarter, where you'll put your formidable reputation to good use by patrolling the Radiant Festival and ensuring the safety of Absalom's most vulnerable visitors. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Society, plus either Gladiatorial Lore or Genealogy Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to interact with members of the Sleepless Suns and residents of the Foreign Quarter. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.
sleepless suns star.source: Agents of Edgewatch Player's Guide pg. 9
sleepless suns star.details: You're trained in the Society, plus either Gladiatorial Lore or Genealogy Lore. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

snubbed out stoolie.name: Snubbed Out Stoolie
snubbed out stoolie.text: Now, not a trace remains of your work for the city. Not only is it as though you were never a shieldmarshal at all, but you've got a rap sheet implicating you as a key member in the criminal organizations you spent your career infiltrating. Luckily, no one could take away the skills you learned from your deep-cover missions, and your new notoriety has earned you quite a reputation among Alkenstar's criminal elite. Through your underworld connections, you've identified Deputy Shieldmarshal Anjelique Loveless as the one responsible for your fall from grace.
snubbed out stoolie.source: Outlaws of Alkenstar Player's Guide pg. 12
snubbed out stoolie.details: You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

sodden scavenger.name: Sodden Scavenger
sodden scavenger.text: You’ve managed to eke out an existence in the storm-wracked Sodden Lands and have become an expert at scavenging food and tools. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Swamp Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
sodden scavenger.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Swamp Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

song of the deep.name: Song of the Deep
song of the deep.text: You gain one ability boost. It must be to Strength, Constitution, or Charisma. You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Ocean Lore skill. You have the ability to breathe underwater. Special You can choose to lose the ability to breathe air when you take this background, making you only able to breathe underwater. If you do, you gain a second ability boost, which is a free ability boost.
song of the deep.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Ocean Lore skill.

songsinger in training.name: Songsinger in Training
songsinger in training.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.
songsinger in training.source: Quest for the Frozen Flame Player's Guide pg. 8
songsinger in training.details: You're trained in the Performance skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

southbank traditionalist.name: Southbank Traditionalist
southbank traditionalist.text: Your home is likely located south of the Ceiba River, on the southernmost outskirts of town. During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time helping to set up the feasts, assisted in running some of the events, and otherwise worked behind the scenes. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because you lost a bet, owed a favor, or otherwise got pressured or tricked into the role by a family member, friend, or coworker. Perhaps someone who was going to be one of the abductees but had to back out at the last moment, and so you ended up taking their place. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free ability boost.
southbank traditionalist.source: Season of Ghosts Player's Guide pg. 12
southbank traditionalist.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Farming Lore skill.

spell seeker.name: Spell Seeker
spell seeker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Arcana or the Occultism skill, as well as the Library Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
spell seeker.source: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide pg. 8
spell seeker.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Arcana or the Occultism skill, as well as the Library Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

sponsored by a stranger.name: Sponsored by a Stranger
sponsored by a stranger.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Occultism or Nature skill. You gain your choice of the Dubious Knowledge or Quick Identification skill feat. You're also trained in Insect Lore. Your recommended primary branch is the Rain-Scribes.
sponsored by a stranger.source: Strength of Thousands Player's Guide pg. 6
sponsored by a stranger.details: You're trained in your choice of the Occultism or Nature skill. You gain your choice of the Dubious Knowledge or Quick Identification skill feat. You're also trained in Insect Lore.

sponsored by a village.name: Sponsored by a Village
sponsored by a village.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Crafting or Survival skill. You gain a skill feat: Crafter's Appraisal if you chose Crafting or Forager if you chose Survival. You're also trained in the Lore skill appropriate for the terrain around your community (such as Forest Lore or Jungle Lore). Your recommended primary branch is the Cascade Bearers.
sponsored by a village.source: Strength of Thousands Player's Guide pg. 7
sponsored by a village.details: You're trained in your choice of the Crafting or Survival skill. You gain a skill feat: Crafter's Appraisal if you chose Crafting or Forager if you chose Survival. You're also trained in the Lore skill appropriate for the terrain around your community (such as Forest Lore or Jungle Lore).

sponsored by family.name: Sponsored by Family
sponsored by family.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Diplomacy or Society skill. You gain a skill feat: Hobnobber if you chose Diplomacy or Eye for Numbers if you chose Society. You're also trained in Magaambya Lore. Your recommended primary branch is the Uzunjati.
sponsored by family.source: Strength of Thousands Player's Guide pg. 6
sponsored by family.details: You're trained in your choice of the Diplomacy or Society skill. You gain a skill feat: Hobnobber if you chose Diplomacy or Eye for Numbers if you chose Society. You're also trained in Magaambya Lore.

sponsored by teacher ot.name: Sponsored by Teacher Ot
sponsored by teacher ot.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of the Survival or Performance skill. You gain a skill feat: Survey Wildlife if you chose Survival or Impressive Performance if you chose Performance. You're also trained in Nantambu Lore. Your recommended primary branch is the Emerald Boughs.
sponsored by teacher ot.source: Strength of Thousands Player's Guide pg. 6
sponsored by teacher ot.details: You're trained in your choice of the Survival or Performance skill. You gain a skill feat: Survey Wildlife if you chose Survival or Impressive Performance if you chose Performance. You're also trained in Nantambu Lore.

spotter.name: Spotter
spotter.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.
spotter.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat.

squire.name: Squire
squire.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Armor Assist skill feat.
squire.details: You trained at the feet of a knight, maintaining their gear and supporting them at tourneys and in battle. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Heraldry Lore skill or Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Armor Assist skill feat.

star athlete.name: Star Athlete
star athlete.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Games Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.
star athlete.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Games Lore skill or a Lore skill associated with your school. You gain the Assurance skill feat with Athletics.

star-browed.name: Star-Browed
star-browed.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fey Lore skill. Once per day, you can cast revealing light as an occult innate spell.
star-browed.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Fey Lore skill.

stargazer.name: Stargazer
stargazer.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, or Occultism skill, and gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill. You're also trained in the Astronomy Lore skill. In addition, you have an innate sense of time. You can ascertain the time accurate to within the hour even without being able to see the sky.
stargazer.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 11
stargazer.details: You're trained in your choice of the Arcana, Nature, or Occultism skill, and gain the Assurance skill feat in your chosen skill. You're also trained in the Astronomy Lore skill.

starless one.name: Starless One
starless one.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Occultism and Astrology Lore. You also gain the Reclaim Destiny action. Reclaim Destiny (divination, occult) Frequency once per day; Trigger You are about to attempt a check and are affected by a fortune or misfortune effect that modifies the triggering check; Effect You break the influence over your fortunes and claim a stable hold over your fate. You ignore the fortune or misfortune effect and can roll the triggering roll normally.
starless one.details: You're trained in Occultism and Astrology Lore.

starwatcher.name: Starwatcher
starwatcher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Astrology Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
starwatcher.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Astrology Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

storm survivor.name: Storm Survivor
storm survivor.text: Through luck or through skill, you managed to survive a catastrophic maritime disaster, such as a shipwreck or being thrown overboard. You have a keen sense for weather or situations that are similar to the one you escaped. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Weather Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.
storm survivor.details: You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Weather Lore skill. You gain the Forager skill feat.

story collector.name: Story Collector
story collector.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat, as well as the following reaction.
story collector.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Demon Lore skill. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat, as well as the following reaction.

street preacher.name: Street Preacher
street preacher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and a Lore skill for your patron deity. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
street preacher.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and a Lore skill for your patron deity. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

street urchin.name: Street Urchin
street urchin.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Thievery skill, and a Lore skill for the city you lived in as a street urchin (such as Absalom Lore or Magnimar Lore). You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.
street urchin.details: You're trained in the Thievery skill, and a Lore skill for the city you lived in as a street urchin (such as Absalom Lore or Magnimar Lore). You gain the Pickpocket skill feat.

streetfood vendor.name: Streetfood Vendor
streetfood vendor.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Seasoned skill feat.
streetfood vendor.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting or the Society skill, as well as the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the Seasoned skill feat.

student of apotheosis.name: Student of Apotheosis
student of apotheosis.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in either the Occultism or Religion skill, as well as the Hero-God Lore skill. You gain the My Legend Must Be Told action. Replace this with the Mythic Echo action when you gain a mythic calling. My Legend Must Be Told Frequency once per day; Trigger Your dying value would reach an amount sufficient to kill you (typically 4); Effect You instead stabilize and increase your doomed value by 1.
student of apotheosis.details: You're trained in either the Occultism or Religion skill, as well as the Hero-God Lore skill.

student of archery.name: Student of Archery
student of archery.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Dexterity, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat and have focused your abilities on a specific type of ranged weapon. Choose a ranged weapon (subject to GM approval). For the purposes of proficiency, if your choice is a martial weapon, you treat it as a simple weapon; if it's an advanced weapon, you treat it as a martial weapon.
student of archery.details: You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat and have focused your abilities on a specific type of ranged weapon.

student of magic.name: Student of Magic
student of magic.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.
student of magic.details: You're trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion, and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Recognize Spell skill feat.

student of the ancients.name: Student of the Ancients
student of the ancients.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill and the Azlanti Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat; one language gained must be Azlanti and the other can be any common or uncommon language
student of the ancients.source: Shades of Blood Player's Guide pg. 11
student of the ancients.details: You're trained in the Society skill and the Azlanti Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat; one language gained must be Azlanti and the other can be any common or uncommon language

sun dancer.name: Sun Dancer
sun dancer.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Dexterity, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Performance. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat. If you use this feat outdoors in direct sunlight, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the skill check.
sun dancer.details: You're trained in Performance. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

supportive sponsor.name: Supportive Sponsor
supportive sponsor.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat. If you have the Guardian persona trait, you also become trained in the Library Lore skill.
supportive sponsor.details: You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Herbalism Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat. If you have the Guardian persona trait, you also become trained in the Library Lore skill.

surge investigator.name: Surge Investigator
surge investigator.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be Constitution or Wisdom and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in your choice of Nature or Occultism and the Magical Terrain Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat.
surge investigator.details: You're trained in your choice of Nature or Occultism and the Magical Terrain Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat.

sword scion.name: Sword Scion
sword scion.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Warfare Lore skill. You gain access to Aldori dueling swords and can purchase one as part of your starting equipment. You treat Aldori dueling swords as martial weapons rather than advanced weapons for the purpose of proficiency.
sword scion.details: You're trained in the Warfare Lore skill.

taldan schemer.name: Taldan Schemer
taldan schemer.text: Whether willing or unwilling, you have been involved in the many cutthroat political intrigues within Taldor. You might have been born into it as a member of the aristocracy, or you might have taken an active role in the recent events of the War for the Crown. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.
taldan schemer.details: You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

tall tale.name: Tall Tale
tall tale.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Performance. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. You can gain the Connections skill feat later without being expert in Society or having Courtly Graces—this represents less traditional social connections and more the way that your legend has spread, and you've learned to leverage your legend, with people wanting to meet you and see you for themselves.
tall tale.details: You're trained in Performance. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. You can gain the Connections skill feat later without being expert in Society or having Courtly Graces—this represents less traditional social connections and more the way that your legend has spread, and you've learned to leverage your legend, with people wanting to meet you and see you for themselves.

tapestry refugee.name: Tapestry Refugee
tapestry refugee.text: Within her magnificent museum demiplane, the sorcerer Hao Jin extracted and preserved countless sites and cultures. The demiplane’s unraveling magic forced the Pathfinder Society to evacuate the many inhabitants recently, and you were among the refugees who returned to the Material Plane after centuries of isolation. Whether you joined the Society out of gratitude, curiosity, or desperation, you are hardened by your harrowing flight from your doomed home. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.
tapestry refugee.details: You're trained in your choice of either the Medicine or the Stealth skill, as well as a Lore skill related to the terrain you lived in while on the demiplane (such as Cave Lore or Desert Lore). You gain the Assurance skill feat with the skill you chose to become trained in (Medicine or Stealth).

tax collector.name: Tax Collector
tax collector.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and a Lore skill for the settlement that employed you. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
tax collector.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and a Lore skill for the settlement that employed you. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in your choice of either the Performance or the Society skill, as well as the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.
teacher.details: You are incredibly knowledgeable, skilled, and perhaps even trained to teach children and adults about the world and its wonders. You're trained in your choice of either the Performance or the Society skill, as well as the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Professional skill feat.

teamster.name: Teamster
teamster.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.
teamster.details: You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the Train Animal skill feat.

tech-reliant.name: Tech-Reliant
tech-reliant.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Medicine skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat, and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells. Healing spells, healing magic items, and magical effects with the healing trait have no effect on you.
tech-reliant.details: You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Medicine skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat, and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells.

thassilonian delver.name: Thassilonian Delver
thassilonian delver.text: As archaeologists uncovered and explored ever-larger numbers of Thassilonian ruins, you were among the eager explorers who sought out the Runelords’ ancient secrets. You may have been the apprentice to another Pathfinder who perished on an expedition, leaving you their discoveries and notes. Or perhaps you explored several of these sites yourself, quickly learning to parse the arcane secrets before lest the eldritch magic extinguish your life. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Thassilonian History Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
thassilonian delver.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Thassilonian History Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.

thassilonian traveler.name: Thassilonian Traveler
thassilonian traveler.text: You come from ancient Thassilon, one of the citizens that appeared out of time alongside the city of Xin-Edasseril. You know many things that have been long forgotten... along with many things that are no longer correct. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Thassilon Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.
thassilonian traveler.details: You're trained in the Arcana skill, and the Thassilon Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

the godchild.name: The Godchild
the godchild.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Astrology Lore skill. You also gain the Invoke Blessing reaction.
the godchild.details: You're trained in the Occultism skill, and the Astrology Lore skill.

the hunted.name: The Hunted
the hunted.text: Choose two attribute boosts. Each boost has to be to Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom. You''re trained in both the Stealth and Survival skills. You gain your choice of either the Terrain Expertise or the Terrain Stalker skill feat.
the hunted.details: You''re trained in both the Stealth and Survival skills. You gain your choice of either the Terrain Expertise or the Terrain Stalker skill feat.

the returned.name: The Returned
the returned.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You''re trained in the First World Lore skill and a skill of your choice. Your time in the First World has given you insight into magic and resistance to its lures. You have a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to see through illusions; this increases to +2 if the illusion is created by a creature with the fey trait.
the returned.details: You''re trained in the First World Lore skill and a skill of your choice.

thrill-seeker.name: Thrill-Seeker
thrill-seeker.text: Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.
thrill-seeker.details: You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

thrune loyalist.name: Thrune Loyalist
thrune loyalist.text: Despite the setbacks Cheliax has suffered recently, your loyalties lie with the devil-backed House Thrune. You consider the current queen to be the rightful ruler of your homeland, and you are willing to act against her enemies. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Hell Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.
thrune loyalist.details: You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Hell Lore skill. You gain the Student of the Canon skill feat.

thuvian unifier.name: Thuvian Unifier
thuvian unifier.text: You believe the city-states of Thuvia should be united into one nation under the rule of your home city (most commonly Aspenthar), and you’re willing to do whatever it takes to make it happen. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.
thuvian unifier.details: You're trained in the Intimidation skill, and the Politics Lore skill. You gain the Quick Coercion skill feat.

tide watcher.name: Tide Watcher
tide watcher.text: Choose two ability boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in Nature and Ocean Lore. During the night when you can see the moon, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to discern weather patterns and predict upcoming weather conditions—this bonus increases to +2 if you're in the vicinity of the ocean.
tide watcher.details: You're trained in Nature and Ocean Lore.

tiffin box deliverer.name: Tiffin Box Deliverer
